Scout and report enemy strength, march direction, and supply positions at once.

Liu Bei:
I accept Guan Yu's plans and give orders.
Sun Qian, present the warehouse list within a quarter hour and state arrival time if en route.
Mi Zhu, name the three most scarce items, mark 'urgent' where needed, and secure one month rations and pay.
If you must summon storekeepers or raise funds, name the responsible persons and do so.
Guan Yu, pick a hundred elite for the mobile force and harass enemy flanks; strengthen gates, ditches, and crossbow towers.
List granary guards and storekeepers; evacuate noncombatants.
All act now and report initial results within ten minutes; I stand ready to issue orders.

Sun Qian:
My formal field report for Fancheng's supplies now.
Grain available about 2000 shi; granary capacity about 8000 shi but some damaged.
Current daily consumption about 200 shi; at present this lasts about ten days.
Spears and halberds about 3000; swords about 1500; armor about 600, of which 500 serviceable.
Bows and crossbows about 1000; arrows about 40,000; arrows will run down quickly in sustained battle.
Treasury can pay about 15 days' soldiers' wages at current standards.
Priority advice: first grain and pay, second bows and arrows, third armor repair, fourth cold weapons.
Warehouse overseen by the warehouse officer; pay disbursement by the treasury clerk with Mi Zhu supervising.
I request authority to press for urgent disbursement and to send a fast rider to test Sun Quan's willingness to help.

Mi Zhu:
My immediate estimate and top three shortages for Fancheng.
Grain about 2000 shi, daily use 200 shi, thus about ten days' supply.
To ensure one month rations we need about 4000 extra shi immediately.
Treasury can pay about 15 days' wages; I request authorization to secure one month pay.
Bows and crossbows about 1000 and arrows about 40,000; ammo needs urgent replenishment.
Armor about 600, with 500 usable; repair and new armor are secondary but needed.
Orders: Sun Qian, present the warehouse list within a quarter hour and name custodians.
Sun Qian, state expected arrival time if the list is en route.
Guan Yu, I will prioritize sealing grain and arranging escorts; I will update with precise numbers in fifteen minutes.

Sun Qian:
Warehouse count ETA and units for the record.
The warehouse officer will present the bound count in about fifteen minutes.
The list will use shi for grain, jin or shi where noted, and pieces for weapons and armor.
For internal delivery use 5–10 escorts; increase to 20 if worried about disturbances.
For long-distance convoys I recommend at least 100 escorts per convoy, 200 if roads or enemy risk are high.
Use side roads and stagger convoys to reduce interception risk; final route to be chosen by Guan Yu.
I will send 10–20 light cavalry to scout and harry now and will report enemy and count when ready.
Please indicate whether the count needs only short escort or long convoy protection.

Liu Bei:
Orders issued and authorized now.
I authorize Mi Zhu temporary funds to secure one month rations and pay.
Mi Zhu and the treasury clerk will supervise disbursement and keep accounts.
Sun Qian, present the warehouse count and immediately dispatch 10–20 scouts to probe Xiahou Dun.
Guan Yu will select the mobile harassment force; Mi Zhu will requisition nearby counties for supplies.
I allow a probe to Sun Quan, but this must not impede urgent supply tasks.
Execute these orders and report an initial update within ten minutes.

Liu Bei:
Guan Yu, you will personally lead the hundred-plus mobile harassment force.
Select a captain and deputy, give their names and departure time at once.
List each granary's guards and storekeepers and hand the list to Mi Zhu for record.
Report within ten minutes: the unit roster, departure time, and granary guard names.

Guan Yu:
Division of labor and immediate orders now.
Sun Qian will present the warehouse list and coordinate long-distance escorts.
Mi Zhu will collect figures, seal the grain, and supervise temporary disbursements.
I will command the scouts, protect granaries, and lead the mobile escort for urgent loads.
For short internal delivery use 5–10 escorts; for long convoys use 100, or 200 if risky.
If the lord authorizes, Mi Zhu and the treasury clerk may begin one month payouts.
Sun Qian and Mi Zhu must deliver exact itemized numbers and custodians within fifteen minutes.

Liu Bei:
Final orders and priorities confirmed.
Sun Qian, prioritize securing funds and present the warehouse count to Mi Zhu.
Sun Qian, dispatch a fast horse to probe Sun Quan, but do not delay counts or scouts.
Mi Zhu, use the treasury to guarantee one month rations and pay and supervise accounts.
Guan Yu, pick leaders and send 10–20 light cavalry to scout and harry; report opportunities to cut supplies.
All report within ten minutes: itemized list or its arrival time, mobile team roster and departure time, and escort routes with required forces.
糜竺:
樊城目前的军需状况如何，请逐项报数。
请报粮草与粮仓存量及每日消耗速度。
请报武器与甲胄、弹药、兵饷余量与消耗。
并说明现在亟需补给项与优先次序及负责人。

关羽:
糜竺，把樊城军需逐项详细报来。
先从最紧缺的三项说起并列明优先级。
并逐项报粮草（斤/石或尽量精确）、日耗与装备可用数。

刘备:
糜竺、关羽、孙乾，诸位听着，樊城军需关系重大。
糜竺，当面上报粮草总量与日均消耗及粮仓可用容积。
并逐项报武器甲胄存量、可装备人数及弹药与消耗率。
把兵饷余额与每月需用、当前紧缺与优先顺序报出并指明负责人姓名与处所。
如需即刻召管库人手或临时筹措军资，先行处理后回报。
糜竺报数后朕来统筹调度，其余听令。

孙乾:
糜君，先报一份现场估计，仓曹正盘点并将呈单。
粮草可用约2000石，粮仓总容量约8000石，部分仓受潮或损毁。
目前日耗约200石，按此可维持约十日，行军或战耗会显著上升。
长兵约3000柄，刀剑约1500把；铠甲约600副，完好约500副需修补。
弓弩约1000副、箭矢约四万支，重甲与新增铠具偏短需优先修铸。
箭矢在战时消耗迅速，按备弹可支数周常规交战，大规模攻防则速显短缺。
库中军资可发约十五日兵饷，若提高粮饷或扩编储备将迅速见底。
建议优先次序：第一粮草與兵饷；第二弓弩與箭矢；第三甲胄修补新增；第四冷兵器。
管库由仓曹主管，兵饷拨发宜由府库主簿与糜竺共同把关。
我等待实盘数字回报，亦可先派快马通江东试探孙权态度与代价。

糜竺:
已收，目前我暂无逐项核实数据。
孙乾，请将你令仓曹清点的逐项盘点单立即呈上并标明单位与日耗与负责人。
若盘点单在路上，请报预计回合 5 到位。
关羽，我将先据现场估计列出最紧缺三项并标明优先级。
待盘点单到手，我将在预计回合 5 到位后回报精确数值与补给建议。

关羽:
陛下、糜竺、孙乾、列位将军，夏侯惇领十万直逼新野。
当前当务以守为主，稳固后方并尽力拖延敌军。
立刻抽轻骑十至二十人出城侦察牵制，务求断其粮道，孙乾即刻执行并回报。
加固城门、壕沟与弩楼，封存粮草，糜竺先报最紧缺三项并保士卒一月口粮与兵饷。
从现有甲胄武器中挑百余精锐成机动队昼夜骚扰敌侧翼，不与主力正面决战。
立即疏散非战斗人员，加强重要粮仓防护并列明护卫与管库人名。
糜竺先报三项，孙乾速派侦察，我可随时率先锋出马受命。

刘备:
孙乾，立刻将你令仓曹清点的逐项盘点单呈上，注明数量单位与日耗。
若盘点单在路上，请报预计回合 5 到位。
糜竺，你先按现场估计把最紧缺三项逐条列出并标明紧急与负责人。
关羽，待两份情报到手你即刻调派护送与护卫，确保补给线畅通。

孙乾:
糜君，盘点单尚在清点，仓曹正装订，预计回合 5 到位。
现可用粮约2000石，日耗约200石，可支约十日。
库中军资可发约十五日兵饷；优先补给顺序仍为一粮草與兵饷、二弓弩與箭矢、三甲胄、四冷兵器。
管库目前由仓曹主管，兵饷拨款宜由府库主簿与糜竺共同把关。
若糜君同意，我可代主公督促速拨优先项，或即派快马通江东试探孙权。

关羽:
孙乾，立刻将令仓曹的逐项盘点单呈上，注明每项数量、单位与日耗。
同时即刻出城派十至二十名轻骑侦察并牵制，摸清夏侯惇行军方向与粮道。
侦察完成后立刻回报敌军兵力、行进方向与补给线位置。
若需护送补给或额外护卫，立即报所需兵力与拟行路线。

刘备:
关羽所提良策朕已采纳。
孙乾，即刻抽轻骑十至二十人出城侦察，摸清夏侯惇行军方向与粮道。
糜竺，先据现场估计报出最紧缺三项并标紧急，立刻封存并保证士卒一月口粮与兵饷。
关羽，从现有甲胄中挑百余精锐成机动队，昼夜骚扰侧翼并加固城门壕沟与弩楼。
组织非战斗人员疏散，列明各粮仓护卫与管库人员名单。
诸位速行，预计回合 4 到位内回报初报，朕随时听命调度。

孙乾:
陛下，就樊城当前军需禀报告如下。
粮草可用约2000石，粮仓容量约8000石，部分受潮损毁。
目前日耗约200石，以此可支约十日，战事加剧消耗将上升。
长兵约3000柄、刀剑约1500把；铠甲约600副，完好约500副需修补。
弓弩约1000副、箭约四万支；重甲与新增铠具偏短。
箭矢在持续交战下消耗快；库中军资可发约十五日兵饷。
紧缺优先：一粮草與兵饷；二弓弩與箭矢；三甲胄修补/新增；四冷兵器。
管库由樊城仓曹主管，兵饷拨发应由府库主簿与糜竺共同把关。
请示陛下是否准我代主公督促拨款并派快马通江东试探孙权。

糜竺:
陛下、关羽、孙乾，就樊城现场估计报最紧缺三项与处置建议。
一、粮草：现有约2000石，日耗约200石，仅能维持十日，需筹约4000石保一月口粮。
粮草须立刻封存，封存清单由仓曹与孙乾当面签字并列护库人名。
二、兵饷：库中仅够约十五日，乞授权临时拨款以确保至少一个月兵饷，我与主簿共同把关。
三、弓弩与箭矢：弓弩约1000副、箭约四万支，战争中消耗极快，建议优先补充修配。
次要：铠甲约600副（完好约500副）需修补与分期添置，冷兵器可稍后补充。
命令：孙乾，盘点单若已成请立刻呈上并注明数量、日耗、管库與拨款负责人。
关羽，请速派十至二十轻骑侦察并挑百余精锐昼夜扰敌侧翼。
陛下，如同意请即授权优先拨付一月口粮與兵饷，我将与主簿监督拨付。
我将按孙乾的实盘数字，预计回合 5 到位后上呈逐项精确数值与补给建议。

孙乾:
关将军，盘点单装订中，预计回合 5 到位。
盘点单将按单位逐项列明并标注日耗与可用或可装备数。
短途呈交盘点单，随从护卫五至十人足矣；若担忧可增至二十人。
若为长途运送，每队护送至少一百人，路险或敌活跃则增至二百人。
长途宜避主干道，走侧路与林间小径并分批护送以降风险，路线由关将定夺。
我已接令，立刻出城派十至二十轻骑侦察并牵制，侦察与盘点单到手即回报。
请关将示意——仅短途护卫或为后续补给配备长途护兵并报所需兵力。

刘备:
糜竺、孙乾、关羽，朕已听明，现下命令如下。
准糜竺临时拨款，优先确保全军一个月口粮與兵饷，糜竺与主簿监督留账。
孙乾立刻将逐项盘点单呈上，并即刻派轻骑十至二十人出城侦察夏侯惇行军与粮道。
关羽按所提挑百余精锐成机动队昼夜扰敌，不与主力相持，并加固城防设施。
糜竺即刻征调附近郡县粮草并筹措护送，必要时府库优先拨银保证补给。
同意试探江东孙权一面，但外交探询不得妨碍补给首务。
诸项即行执行，预计回合 4 到位内将初报回朕。

刘备:
关羽，朕已采纳你的建议，令你亲率百余精锐为机动骚扰队。
你昼夜轮换出城扰敌侧翼，但不得与敌主力相持。
即刻挑定机动队队长与副将，报其姓名与出发时间。
并将各粮仓护卫與管库人名列单上交糜竺存档备案。
诸事十分钟内回报机动队名单、出发时刻与侦察路线与需护送兵力，预计回合 4 到位。

关羽:
陛下、糜竺、孙乾，现就分工与当务回报并下令如下。
分工：孙乾负责盘点单呈交与护送并统筹长途护送。
糜竺负责收数、封存粮草并拟定优先拨付方案与监督拨款。
我负责指挥轻骑侦察与粮仓护卫，并组织机动队护送最紧急物资。
护送强度：城内短途五至十人；长途每队至少一百人，险恶则二百人。
孙乾、糜竺：盘点单到手后，预计回合 5 到位内把逐项精确数字、负责人名录及护送计划上报。
关羽随时待命护送与调度，请速行。

刘备:
孙乾、糜竺、关羽，朕已悉报。
孙乾，准你优先筹补粮饷，速将逐项盘点单亲呈糜竺并报于朕。
盘点单须注明数量、可用率或可装备人数、日耗、管库與拨款负责人，若在路上请报预计回合 5 到位。
并即刻派快马试探江东孙权，携行书与使节，但不得妨碍本城盘点与侦察要务。
你与糜竺一并拟定护送路线與所需兵力，交关羽执行护卫。
糜竺，即动用府库临时拨银保证全军一个月口粮與兵饷，并与你与主簿共同监督留账。
关羽，按命选定机动骚扰队长与副将，并派轻骑十至二十人出城侦察，且上呈粮仓护卫與管库人员名单。
诸事十分钟内回报：逐项盘点单或到达时间、机动队与侦察名单与出发时刻、护送路线與所需兵力，预计回合 4 到位。
Scene 4 · Xinye · rounds 2–20
Xu Chu:
General Zhao, I am Xu Chu. Since you have come to Xinye, speak plainly your purpose.
How many accompany you, what is this mission, and what are your current plans and the enemy situation? Tell us so we can assess the situation.

Zhao Yun:
General Xu, do you know the current situation in Xinye? Are enemy forces active nearby or are there allies we can rely on?

Zhao Yun:
General Xu, I am Zhao Yun, sent by my lord to scout Xinye and probe the enemy.
I have just over thirty personal guards with me, not here to wage war but to reconnoiter; we will act on clear intelligence.
So far I have seen no large Cao army formations, only scattered raiders and stragglers; I request your counsel on available aid and dispositions, and whether you will cooperate.

Xu Chu:
General Zhao, to report back: within Xinye I have seen no large Cao formations; only scattered raiders and stray soldiers on the roads.
The city's garrison is thin and our available forces here are limited; we would struggle in a head-on fight with Cao's main force.
Since you emphasize reconnaissance, you must remain concealed and confirm enemy dispositions; please state where exactly you are outside the city and whether your thirty-plus men can be quartered inside or need escort.

Zhao Yun:
General Xu, I am currently positioned outside Xinye's south gate with just over thirty followers.
I am willing to enter for concealment and to assist in defense; if entry is inconvenient, please send a few escorts and name a safe rendezvous.
Kindly tell me how many troops you can spare inside and where they are deployed, and advise whether I should continue covert scouting, cooperate in the garrison, or withdraw to await reinforcements.

Xu Chu:
General Zhao, Xu Chu reports: the city's defenses are indeed thin; I can immediately spare about ten elite soldiers to cover you.
You may enter and hide in an old warehouse or inn east of the south gate; I will send men to guide you covertly and arrange pickets.
If you prefer to withdraw, I can assign escort and name South River Bridge as a temporary rendezvous; now tell me your exact position outside the south gate, whether you have wounded, and whether you will enter now or need cover to withdraw.

Zhao Yun:
General Xu, Zhao Yun remains outside the south gate with over thirty men and will enter to hide and scout and to assist the garrison if permitted.
If entry is not possible, send escorts and state a safe rendezvous point; please clarify the troops you can use, their deployments, and whether I should continue covert scouting, help defend, or withdraw to await aid.
If you intend me to garrison or strike, state the measures you will take and the tasks my men should perform.

Zhao Yun:
(inner monologue: (thinking): Assessment — no large Cao formations yet in Xinye, only scattered raiders; the city's defenses are weak. Zhao Yun (thinking): Xu Chu can spare roughly ten elite soldiers to cover us; we may accept his offer to hide east of the south gate in the old warehouse or inn. Zhao Yun (thinking): We will cooperate in covert reconnaissance and report findings promptly for deployment; if the enemy strength grows, withdraw via the South River Bridge and call for reinforcements. Zhao Yun (thinking): Conclusion — short-term garrisoning and scouting acceptable, avoid frontal battle, rely on Xu Chu and swift reinforcement.)

Xu Chu:
(dispatches ten elite soldiers to the south gate outside Xinye to cover Zhao Yun, covertly guiding Zhao Yun and his followers into the old warehouse or inn on the east side of the south gate; pickets and hidden guides are posted around the area and South River Bridge is prepared as the withdrawal rendezvous.)

Zhao Yun:
General Xu, I accept entry and will hide temporarily.
Please send guides to lead me and my over thirty followers to the old warehouse or inn east of the south gate, and assign about ten elite to cover us and set pickets; I will enter and immediately report any intelligence.
Tell me who will lead the escort and when they will be in position so we can coordinate.

Xu Chu:
General Zhao, I will personally lead the guiding party.
Ten elite have departed and are en route; they will split into an escort team and a guiding team, covering alley mouths east and west of the south gate.
Pickets will be oriented toward South River Bridge; the rally point is three zhang south of the south gate beneath the large locust tree, signal being three claps.
The temporary lodging remains the old warehouse or inn east of the south gate; enter and report your reconnaissance to me at once.
Please report your exact number of followers, whether there are wounded and their condition, and whether you carry banners or torches to aid concealment, and state your present position relative to the south gate.
If you agree to enter, wait at the rally point and move on the signal; if you choose withdrawal, follow my directions toward South River Bridge. What say you, General Zhao?
许褚:
赵将军，我是许褚。
你到新野的来意为何？随行兵力多少？现在的打算与敌情如何？请直言以便评估局势。

赵云:
许将军，你可知新野目前的情势？四周可有敌军活动或可依靠的盟友？

赵云:
许将军，我是赵云，奉主公差遣前来探查新野形势。
我旨在刺探敌情并寻可依靠之人，随行不过三十余名亲兵，非来征伐。
当前以侦查为主，待得明确情报再议行动。路上见有零散劫掠与散兵，未见曹军成规模列阵。
还请许将军直言此处实情、在此可用之援兵与部署，若许将军愿合力，我等可即刻配合驻守或行动。

许褚:
赵将军，承你所言：新野境内至今未见曹军成规模列阵，路上仅有零散劫掠与散兵出没。
城内守备并不充裕，我方在此可动用兵力有限，若与曹军正面交锋恐难独撑。
既然你以侦查为主，务须隐蔽探明敌情。还请告知你此刻具体在新野何处？
随行三十余人能否暂驻城内或需我安排掩护？你是否欲与在地可依靠之人联络，或打算即刻撤离？下一步打算为何，需我等何种配合？

赵云:
许将军，我暂驻新野城南门外，随行三十余人。
若许将军允我入城暂驻以便隐蔽侦查，我愿配合驻守并按令行事；若不便，还请派遣数名掩护并指明一处安全接应点。
请直言城内可动用兵力多少、部署在何处？你建议我下一步继续暗中侦查、协同守备，还是暂时撤离以待援兵？赵云敬禀。

许褚:
赵将军，回报：城中守备不足，我可立即抽调约十名精兵前来掩护。
你可入城暂驻，先在南门东侧一处旧仓库或客栈隐蔽，我会派人暗中引领并布置接应哨位。
若你愿与我合力守备，可即刻入城报到并详告侦查所得以便部署；若欲先撤离，我可指派护卫并指定南河桥为临时接应点。
请回报你现今在南门外的更精确位置、是否有伤员、是否当即入城或需掩护撤退？赵将军意下如何？

赵云:
许将军，赵云暂驻新野城南门外，随行三十余人。
愿入城暂隐侦查并协助守备；若不便入城，还请遣数名掩护并指明一处安全接应点。
请直言城内可动用兵力多少、现役部署均驻何处？你建议我继续暗中侦查并与城内协防，抑或暂时撤离以待援兵？
若许将军欲我配合驻守或出击，请明示拟采取之措施与我等应承担之任务，赵云敬禀。

赵云:
(inner monologue: 评估：新野暂未见曹军成规模列阵，城内守备不足，许褚可抽调约十名精兵掩护。 可接受许褚允准，暂隐于南门东侧旧仓库或客栈，配合暗中侦查并将情报及时上报以便部署。 若敌情突变或遇大敌，应利用许褚指定的南河桥撤离并请求外援。 总体判断：可短期驻守兼侦查，不可正面交锋，需依赖许褚与迅速获取援兵。)

许褚:
(派出十名精兵赶赴新野南门外掩护赵云。 许褚暗中引领赵云及其三十余名随从进入南门东侧的旧仓库或客栈暂驻。 许褚在周边布置接应哨位与隐蔽引导，预设南河桥为撤离接应点，以便隐蔽侦查与必要撤退。)

赵云:
许将军，赵云接受入城暂驻。
请即派人引领我与三十余名随从前往南门东侧之旧仓库或客栈，并指派约十名精兵为掩护与布置接应哨位。
吾将随即入城，入内后立刻将所侦得情报详报以便布置。请回报引领者與掩护何人、何时到位，以便我等配合。

许褚:
由我许褚亲自领引。
十名精兵已出发，即刻赶至南门外到位，分为引导小队与掩护小队。
掩护点兼顾南门东西两侧巷口，哨位向南河桥方向预设。
引领集合点为南门外正南三丈处那株大槐树下，暗号为我拍掌三次。
入内暂驻处仍为南门东侧旧仓库或客栈，入内后请立刻将侦得情报详报我以便部署。
请回报你与随从的确切人数、是否有伤员及伤情、是否携带旗帜或火把，并说明你现在相对于南门的更精确位置。
若你同意入城，按集合处待命见暗号即进；若欲撤离，改按我指示向南河桥撤出。赵将军意下如何？
Scene 5 · Xuchang · rounds 2–21
Yue Jin:
Xun Yu, Cheng Yu, counsellors and generals, I report the current military situation; my lord, please instruct our next deployment.

Zhang Liao:
All, Xuchang's situation is urgent; I have summoned the advisers to discuss Xuchang's defense and response plans, so state your observations and recommendations.

Cheng Yu:
The immediate duty is to hold Xuchang, protect the Son of Heaven, and secure military supplies.
First, seal the outer gates, strengthen the walls, post crossbowmen on the battlements with day-and-night rotations, and avoid alarming the populace.
Second, detach light cavalry in three routes to scout, sever the enemy's supply lines, and set ambushes on necessary roads to hold the enemy.
Third, the main force shall defend the city passes and inner strongpoints and keep an elite reserve for contingencies; Xiahou Dun will oversee inner and outer guards, Xiahou Yuan will lead cavalry patrols, Yue Jin will oversee provisions, Yu Jin will hold the north gate, and Commander Zhang Liao will take overall command.
Fourth, quickly inventory arms and provisions and guard against leaks to steady the troops' morale.
Fifth, order Xun Yu and myself to secretly reconnoitre the enemy and report movements swiftly.
Additionally, I wish to verify Xu Shu and his mother's situation covertly; if feasible, summon that worthy by family letter to add counsel, and I will act on occasion—please direct, Commander.

Emperor Xian of Han:
Yue Jin, I have heard you; my orders are as follows.
Send elite scouts outside the city to track the approaching enemy day and night and report quickly.
Strictly guard Xuchang's gates and main roads and forbid unauthorized sorties.
Immediately strengthen palace guards to secure the inner court and those close to me.
Confer closely with Xun Yu and Cheng Yu to list needed reinforcements and provisions; designate Zhang Liao, Xiahou Dun, and Xiahou Yuan as emergency commanders.
Report what you learn to me at once; I will await the next dispatch.

Xun Yu:
Commander Zhang Liao and generals, thank you for convening this council.
Our three chief duties are to preserve the emperor, hold Xuchang, and safeguard grain and communications.
I propose immediate measures to be refined after your reports: close and secure the city, reinforce palace guards, and control gates and internal access.
Place heavy forces on the north and south roads and major crossings and build temporary obstacles outside the walls to stop enemy cavalry.
Dispatch light cavalry and scouts day and night to discover enemy main directions and supply lines.
Secure granaries and military stores, have trusted officers guard them, and prevent disturbance to civilians.
Each general report how many troops you can send for garrison, gate duty, and scouts—Zhang Liao, Xiahou Dun, Xiahou Yuan, Yue Jin, Yu Jin, Cheng Yu please state your numbers.
Cheng Yu and I will then draft a detailed defense and mobile operations plan based on those reports; speak now of your forces.

Xu Shu:
Commander Zhang Liao and gentlemen, the situation is urgent and I advise defence first, with external measures as support.
Reinforce Xuchang's gates and outer ditch at once, supply bows and crossbows, and rotate local militia and elite troops at the strongpoints.
Control waterways by dispatching light cavalry and river forces to seal Han River and Yellow River crossings with constant watch to prevent secret crossings.
Prepare mobile forces under Xiahou Yuan and Xiahou Dun as cavalry reserves to strike weak enemy wings when opportunity arises.
Protect supply lines by placing obstacles and ambushes toward Chenliu and Runan and organize escort teams for provisions.
Let Xun Yu and Cheng Yu manage scouts and external patrols to guard against enemy ruses and internal collaborators.
Prepare several secure withdrawal routes to preserve the commander and the emperor if the situation reverses.
If you permit, I will immediately draft the detailed disposition of troops and sentry assignments.

Emperor Xian of Han:
Cheng Yu's five measures are sound, and I approve them; carry them out at once.
Seal the outer gates, strengthen the walls, post crossbowmen with day-and-night rotation, and avoid alarming the people.
Detach light cavalry in three routes to scout and sever enemy supply, and post ambushes on necessary roads while tracking the enemy day and night.
Have the main force defend city passes and inner strongpoints and maintain an elite reserve for response; assign Xiahou Dun to oversee inner and outer guards, Xiahou Yuan to lead cavalry patrols, Yue Jin to supervise provisions, Yu Jin to guard the north gate, with Zhang Liao in overall command.
Immediately inventory arms and provisions and guard against leaks to steady the army.
Order Xun Yu and Cheng Yu to covertly investigate the enemy and report swiftly.
Cheng Yu may covertly verify Xu Shu and his mother, and if feasible, recall that worthy by family letter; I permit this—execute promptly and report.

Xu Shu:
Cheng Yu, I accept and find your points essential.
I concur: seal the outer gates, erect battlements and place crossbows with round-the-clock rotation to keep defenses credible.
Send light cavalry in three routes to scout and sever supplies and set ambushes on Chenliu and Runan to restrain the enemy.
Hold the main force on the city passes and keep an elite reserve for response—Xiahou Dun to oversee guards, Xiahou Yuan to lead patrols, Yue Jin to supervise provisions, Yu Jin to guard the north gate, with Zhang Liao commanding overall.
Inventory arms and provisions at once and guard against leaks to steady morale.
Place Xun Yu and Cheng Yu in charge of scouts to covertly observe and report.
On recalling Xu Shu by family letter, be extremely cautious and first verify the facts to prevent enemy infiltration; if Cheng Yu agrees, I will immediately draft sentry assignments and troop dispositions for Cheng Yu and Zhang Liao to review.

Zhang Liao:
Cheng Yu, your counsel is heeded; your plans are excellent.
Execute them now: seal outer gates, strengthen walls, station crossbowmen with day-and-night rotations and avoid alarming the populace.
Order Xiahou Dun to oversee inner and outer guards and have Xiahou Yuan lead light cavalry in three routes out of the city to scout and ambush on necessary roads to cut the enemy's supplies.
Keep an elite reserve in the city passes for rapid response; inventory arms and provisions immediately and guard against internal leaks; Yue Jin supervise provisions and Yu Jin hold the north gate; Xun Yu and Cheng Yu will covertly watch the enemy and report.
Cheng Yu may covertly verify Xu Shu and his mother and act when suitable; begin deployment and report progress.

Xiahou Dun:
Gentlemen, I accept the measures you have outlined and issue these orders.
Seal outer gates at once, assign more crossbowmen to battlements with round-the-clock rotation, and strictly control entrances to steady the people.
Send light cavalry out in three routes to scout and cut enemy supplies; Xiahou Yuan will lead the patrols and return swift reports.
Yu Jin will guard the north gate, Yue Jin oversee provisions, and Xun Yu and Cheng Yu will covertly reconnoitre and report.
The main force will hold the city passes and inner strongpoints and keep an elite reserve for contingencies; I will supervise inner and outer guards while Commander Zhang Liao has overall command.
Each commander report how many troops they can deploy for gate duty and scouting; implement at once and detain any suspicious persons to prevent internal collaborators.

Yu Jin:
Commander Zhang Liao, Cheng Yu, Xun Yu and generals, I adopt the counselors' plans and issue orders now.
Seal the outer gates and reinforce the walls, post crossbowmen on the battlements with day-and-night rotation.
Yue Jin, immediately inventory the provisions and place trusted officers to guard the granaries.
Xiahou Dun will oversee inner and outer guards while Xiahou Yuan leads light cavalry in three routes to scout and intercept the enemy's supply lines.
Yu Jin will hold the north gate and link with the elite reserve for response; Commander Zhang Liao will coordinate overall and guard against internal leaks.
Xun Yu and Cheng Yu are responsible for covert reconnaissance and immediate reporting; each of you state how many troops you can allocate to gate duty and scouts for prompt deployment.

Cheng Yu:
Xu Shu, I would privately ask after your filial devotion—how is your mother faring?
If you permit, I would like one family letter to verify the handwriting in private.

Emperor Xian of Han:
Xun Yu, Cheng Yu, Zhang Liao, Xiahou Dun, Xiahou Yuan, Yue Jin, Yu Jin, Xu Shu—your reports are received and I approve Xun Yu's emergency measures.
Close the city defenses at once and reinforce palace guards around the court.
Post heavy forces on north and south routes and main crossings and build temporary obstacles to stop enemy cavalry.
Dispatch light cavalry and scouts in three routes day and night to discover enemy main directions and supply lines and report speedily.
Immediately inventory arms and provisions, secure granaries under Yue Jin's supervision, and have each general report available garrison and patrol forces so Xun Yu, Cheng Yu and I can finalize plans; report what you learn.

Zhang Liao:
Your Imperial decree is received, I will comply.
I will immediate order the five approved measures: seal the outer gates, reinforce walls, post crossbowmen day and night; assign Xiahou Dun to oversee guards, Xiahou Yuan to lead cavalry in routes to cut supplies and set ambushes, Yue Jin to supervise provisions, Yu Jin to hold the north gate, and keep an elite reserve at the passes; we will inventory arms and provisions and report what we find.

Xiahou Dun:
Your Majesty, I obeyed the orders at once and report implementation.
I have ordered the sealing of outer gates and deployed extra crossbowmen with round-the-clock rotation to control the entrances.
Light cavalry have been dispatched in three routes to scout under Xiahou Yuan's command; Yu Jin holds the north gate and Yue Jin oversees provisions and military stores.
Xun Yu and Cheng Yu are conducting covert observation and will report quickly; main forces hold the city passes and inner strongpoints with an elite reserve ready; Commander Zhang Liao coordinates overall, and we are counting arms and provisions and will report troop and patrol figures as ordered.

Xiahou Yuan:
Your Majesty, Commander Zhang Liao, and Xiahou Dun, I will immediately organize my light cavalry into three routes to scout and cut enemy supplies.
I request permission from the emperor and Commander Zhang Liao to set out, and guidance on how many troops may be deployed and how often I should report.

Yue Jin:
My lord has adopted Cheng Yu's five measures and ordered them executed at once: seal the outer gates, strengthen walls, place crossbowmen day and night and rotate them.
Detach light cavalry in three routes to scout and ambush on key roads and track the enemy day and night; main forces hold city passes and inner points with an elite reserve for contingencies.
Immediately inventory arms and provisions and prevent leaks to steady the troops; Xiahou Dun will oversee guards, Xiahou Yuan lead patrols, I supervise provisions, Yu Jin holds the north gate, and Zhang Liao commands overall.
I have begun deployments and set the scouts in motion; please advise whether external reinforcements are required or further troop adjustments, and each general report available garrison and scout numbers so we can coordinate; Xun Yu and Cheng Yu may expand on mobile defense and key strongpoints.

Emperor Xian of Han:
Xiahou Dun, I have received your report and give these orders.
First, promptly report to the court the exact numbers of troops available for garrison, patrols and scouts, the quantities of weapons and provisions, and the locations where they are stationed.
Second, detain any suspicious persons and bring them before the palace for examination; do not release them without orders.
Third, scout reports on enemy dispositions, main routes and supply lines must be sent day and night, and if enemy forces approach, sound the alarm and report at once; act with utmost caution.

Xiahou Dun:
Xiahou Yuan, you are authorized to organize your light cavalry into three scouting routes.
Each route must not exceed three hundred light cavalry; first report the exact numbers you can commit and the routes and stations for each.
Report twice daily at sunrise and sunset, and immediately report any enemy contact or discovered supply traces, prioritizing immediate warning and retreat to strong terrain when engaged.
Each unit must carry a liaison officer to communicate with the command staff and coordinate with Yue Jin, Yu Jin, Cheng Yu, and Xun Yu; no single rider shall penetrate alone or pursue to the point of losing contact; secure supplies and conceal at night and detain any suspicious persons for questioning; act swiftly and report back.

Xiahou Yuan:
Your Majesty, Commander Zhang Liao, Xiahou Dun and all generals, I report my available cavalry.
I have about three hundred light cavalry and can divide them into three routes of roughly one hundred each to scout and sever the enemy's supply lines.
I will leave thirty to fifty men as reserve and to guard key crossings and roads within the city.
Each route will take scouts and carry several light crossbows suited to ambush and harassment.
I can assemble and depart within one hour, and propose reporting at dawn and dusk as routine and instantly upon encountering the enemy; please authorize this deployment or instruct any adjustments to numbers or report frequency.

Xun Yu:
Yue Jin, take grain and provisions as the first priority and report specifics to me and Zhang Liao in writing.
Count the main granary and reserve stores: quantities of grain and cloth, available sacks, garrison numbers and assigned sentry posts, and send the written tally without delay.
Immediately post elite troops to guard the principal granaries, establish inner and outer checkpoints, and strictly prevent internal collusion or private diversion.
If you find weak points or require reinforcements, list the needed troops, positions and equipment, and I will coordinate supplies and deployment; act swiftly and report.

Xu Shu:
Cheng Yu, I accept your inquiry; my mother has been detained in Xuchang and is disturbed in body and mind, and I worry for her condition.
On the matter of using a family letter to verify handwriting, this concerns privacy and hearts, so we must be extremely cautious.
If you promise to verify secretly and not disclose it, I can provide either the original family letter or a copy for handwriting confirmation and will demand its return after verification.
I ask that you report the verification results to the proper commanders quickly and keep others from touching it; if you approve, tell me how and when to hand it over.

Zhang Liao:
Xiahou Dun, I have heard your arrangements and give these orders.
Seal the outer gates and increase crossbowmen with day-and-night rotation to control entrances and steady the populace.
Xiahou Yuan will lead the light cavalry in three routes to scout and set ambushes on necessary roads to disrupt enemy supplies; keep an elite reserve in the city passes to respond.
Yue Jin will oversee provisions and Yu Jin will hold the north gate; Cheng Yu and Xun Yu will covertly reconnoitre and report any enemy movements.
All commanders report at once the troops available for garrison and scouting, implement orders without delay, and detain suspicious persons to prevent internal collusion; I will coordinate overall.

Cheng Yu:
Xu Shu, I am grateful for your consent and discretion.
To prevent leaks and preserve trust, please name a trusted messenger or allow me to fetch the family letter personally for handwriting verification; it will be returned and not shown to others.
Indicate the place and time for transfer, or if I am to collect it directly, let me know so I may keep full responsibility and secrecy.
乐进:
荀彧、程昱诸位谋士、各位将军，末将汇报当前军情，望主公裁示下一步。

张辽:
诸位，许昌形势紧迫，今召谋臣共议防务与应对方案，请各自陈述所见与建议。

程昱:
都督，首务在固守许昌，保全天子与军需。
即刻封固外门，加固城墙，垛口置弩兵昼夜轮换，勿惊扰民心。
抽调轻骑分三路出城侦察、断敌粮道，并在必经要道设伏牵制敌军。
主力据城中隘口与内城要点布防，并设精锐预备队以便应变。
命夏侯惇督内外卫，夏侯渊率骑巡逻，乐进督粮草，于禁守北门，张都督总摄。
速清点军器粮饷，严防内泄以稳军心。
令荀彧与程昱暗中察敌并速报动向。
臣愿暗中核实徐庶与其母之情，若可召回贤士，臣将择机奏行。

汉献帝:
乐进，朕已听你禀，现下旨如下。
速派精骑在城外严密侦察，昼夜追踪来敌行迹并速报。
严守许昌城门与要道，禁绝擅自出城巡猎。
立刻加固宫城护卫，确保后宫与朕近臣安全。
与荀彧、程昱等谋士密议防务，列出需援军与粮饷名单。
所需援军以张辽、夏侯惇、夏侯渊为应急指挥，所闻速奏。

荀彧:
张辽、诸位将军，多谢召集。
首务三事：保全天子、固守许昌、稳全粮饷与通讯。
即刻闭城要塞，严控城门与内应，御林宿卫加固宫廷周边。
设重兵扼守南北两路与主要渡口，并在城外筑临时障壕阻骑入。
派出轻骑与斥候昼夜侦探，查明敌主力方向与补给线。
稳固粮仓与军需，派要员把守并防止扰民生乱。
各将军报告可出动兵力与守门、侦骑数目，吾与程昱据此定详策。

徐庶:
张辽都督、诸位，当前军情紧要，吾以守城为主、外防为辅。
立刻加固许昌城门与外壕，补足弓弩火器，乡勇与精锐轮值。
严控水险，派轻骑与水师查封汉水、黄河渡口，设哨不辍。
预置机动力量，令夏侯渊、夏侯惇各领骑兵为机动预备队。
固守要道与补给线，在陈留、汝南方向布置路障与伏兵护运粮草。
荀彧与程昱主理探马外调，防敌诈动与内应。
预设数条安全撤退通道，以备形势逆转时保全主帅与天子。
若诸位许可，某可即刻细列兵力布置与哨位分配。

汉献帝:
程昱言之有理，朕承准其五策并下令即行。
即刻封固外门、加固城墙，垛口置弩兵昼夜轮换，勿惊扰民心。
抽调轻骑分三路出城侦察、断敌粮道，并在必经要道设伏追踪来敌。
主力据城中隘口与内城要点布防，设精锐预备队以应变。
夏侯惇督内外卫，夏侯渊率骑巡逻，乐进督粮草，于禁守北门，张都督总摄。
速清点军器粮饷，严防内泄；准程昱暗核徐庶与其母之事，可择机奏行。

徐庶:
程公亮，承览善策，诸点皆切要。
某愿从命采纳：立刻封固外门、加垛置弩昼夜轮换，使城防不虚。
分三路轻骑出城侦察，并在陈留、汝南等必经要道设伏牵制。
主力据隘口布防，设精锐预备队；夏侯惇、夏侯渊、乐进、于禁、张都督之任如所述。
速清点军器粮饷，严防内泄；令荀彧与程公督探马暗察敌情速报。
关于以家书召回徐庶一事，须先暗核其实，若允，某可呈哨位与兵力布置草案。

张辽:
程昱，吾受教，诸策甚善，照此行事。
即刻封固外门、加固城墙，垛口置弩昼夜轮换，勿惊扰民心。
命夏侯惇督内外卫，夏侯渊率轻骑分三路出城侦察并设伏断敌粮道。
以精锐为预备队据城中隘口与要点应变；速清点军器粮饷，严防内泄。
乐进督粮草，于禁守北门；令荀彧与程昱暗中察敌，程卿可暗核徐庶与其母之事。

夏侯惇:
诸位，承诸位所陈，末将裁示如下。
即刻封固外门，加派弩手昼夜轮换，严控出入口以稳民心。
分三路轻骑出城侦探，断敌补给，夏侯渊统领巡逻速回情报。
于禁守北门，乐进督粮草与军需；程昱、荀彧暗察敌情并速报。
主力据城中隘口与内城要点布防，设精锐预备队以应变；张辽总摄指挥。
各位速报可出动兵数及守门、侦骑配备，遇可疑者即行收押，严防内应。

于禁:
张辽都督、程公、荀公、各位将军，承二公所议。
即刻封固外门、加固城墙，垛口置弩兵昼夜轮换。
乐进速清点粮草并以要员把守粮仓。
夏侯惇督内外卫，夏侯渊率轻骑分三路出城侦察并截断敌粮道。
于禁督守北门，并与精锐预备队联应以应变。
张都督总摄全局；荀彧、程昱专责暗察敌情并即时回报。

程昱:
徐公，微臣私问一事，闻徐公至孝，不知尊母近况可好？
如许可，愿借一纸家书以验笔迹，望徐公允诺。

汉献帝:
荀彧、程昱、张辽、夏侯惇、夏侯渊、乐进、于禁、徐庶，朕悉诸公所陈。
准荀彧所拟数项紧急布置并即行：先闭城要塞，严控城门，御林宿卫加固宫廷周边。
在南北要路与主要渡口设重兵并筑临时障壕，阻敌骑突入。
分三路遣轻骑与斥候昼夜侦探，查明敌主力方向与补给线并速报。
速清点军器粮饷，稳固粮仓与军需，由乐进督之；各将速报可出动守城兵力与侦骑数目。

张辽:
陛下圣裁，张辽谨遵。
臣即刻督促诸将施行所准五策：封固外门、加固城墙、昼夜布弩。
命夏侯惇督内外卫，夏侯渊率骑分路断敌粮道并设伏。
乐进督粮草，于禁守北门；以精锐为预备队据隘口应变。
军器粮饷即刻清点，所闻即奏。

夏侯惇:
禀陛下，末将遵旨。
已令即刻封固外门，加派弩手昼夜轮换，严控出入口。
分三路轻骑出城侦探，夏侯渊统领巡逻；于禁守北门，乐进督粮草。
程昱、荀彧密察敌情并速报；主力据守城中隘口与内城要点，设精锐预备队。
张辽总摄指挥，各部正清点兵器粮饷并报可出动兵数，现已下令落实。

夏侯渊:
陛下、张都督、诸位将军，遵旨。
属下愿即刻整顿轻骑，分三路出城侦察，断敌粮道并择机奔袭。
恳请陛下与张都督准予出征整顿，并示可出动兵力与回报频率。

乐进:
主公已采纳程昱所陈五策并下旨即行，末将已着手布置侦骑。
即刻封固外门、加固城墙、昼夜置弩并轮换；抽调轻骑分三路出城侦察并在要道设伏。
主力据城中隘口与内城要点布防，设精锐预备队；速清点军器粮饷，严防内泄。
夏侯惇督内外卫、夏侯渊率骑巡逻、乐进督粮草、于禁守北门，张辽总摄指挥。
伏乞陛下明示是否需派出外援或进一步调兵；诸将请报可出动兵力与侦骑配备以便统筹。

汉献帝:
夏侯惇，朕承你禀。
速将各处可出动守城、巡逻与侦骑之兵数、兵器與粮饷余量及驻守地点详报朝廷。
凡遇可疑者即行收押，带至宫外候审，不得擅放。
斥候所得敌情、主力路向与补给线情报须昼夜速报，若敌接近即刻鸣钟入奏。

夏侯惇:
夏侯渊，准你整顿三路轻骑出城侦察。
每路出动不可逾三百轻骑，先报此次可出动的实际兵数与各路行进路线及驻点。
回报频率为日出、日落各一次，若遇敌情即刻优先报讯并退守坚固地形。
每队须配一名联络官直接与都督部联络，并与乐进、于禁、程昱、荀彧保持情报通合。
严禁单骑深入敌后或擅自追击致与主力失联，注意补给与夜间隐蔽。
凡遇可疑人物即行收押审问，速行，速回情报。

夏侯渊:
陛下、张都督、将军们，属下禀报可出动轻骑与配备。
属下麾下轻骑约三百人，可整编为三路出城侦察，每路约一百骑。
另留三十至五十人为预备与城内应急，把守重要渡口与要道。
随骑配斥候若干，并携轻弩数架以便伏袭与牵制。
属下可于一时辰内整顿完毕出发，回报平时晨暮各例报，遇敌即刻速报。
恳请陛下、张都督、夏侯惇裁示准予出征整顿，若有增减兵数或改回报频率之令，请示下达。

荀彧:
乐进，已悉。
你以粮饷为重，务必即刻清点主仓与分储实数，书面速报于我与张辽。
立刻派精兵昼夜把守主要粮仓，设内外两道哨卡并严防内应与私运。
若查得薄弱处或需增援，请明列所需兵力与器械，我即统筹拨补。速行，所闻即奏。

徐庶:
程公，承公关怀。
尊母近日被牵连留于许昌，身心受扰，近况尚不稳，某心甚忧。
关于借家书验笔迹一事，事关隐私与人心，须慎之又慎。
若程公保证暗中核实、绝不外泄，微臣可呈上一纸家书或摹本以供验认；验毕即归。
望程公将核实结果速行稟奏，勿令他人染指；若程公以为妥，某可安排交付人选与时辰。

张辽:
夏侯惇，承你所陈，照此施行。
即刻封固外门，加派弩手昼夜轮换，严控出入口以稳民心。
命夏侯渊统领轻骑分三路出城侦察并在必经要道设伏，力求断敌粮道。
以精锐为预备队据城中隘口与要点以应变；乐进督粮草，于禁守北门。
令程昱、荀彧暗中察敌并速报动向；各位将领即刻上报可出动兵数与配备，吾总摄指挥。

程昱:
徐公，蒙允相助，程某不胜感激。
为防泄露与人心生变，尚请徐公指定一名可信之人，或允程某亲往取回一封家书或摹本以验笔迹。
验毕必当归还不外示他人，尚请指明交付之处与时辰；若允程某亲往，当告以便，程某必全权保密。
Scene 6 · Xiangyang · rounds 3–3
Cai Mao:
(He stands before the Xiangyang garrison and gives orders. Hold the gates as already arranged. Cai He will guard the east gate. Cai Zhong will guard the south gate. Cai Xun will guard the north gate. The west gate remains blocked by Tanxi; no sentries needed. Detach five hundred elite troops at once. They ambush the mansions. They also cover the inner-city approaches. No outsiders may enter or leave the city. Be ready at all times to support Kuai Yue and Cai Furen.)
蔡瑁:
(向襄阳守军下达命令。 按既定部署，严守城门。 蔡和守东门，蔡中守南门，蔡勋守北门。 西门以檀溪为障，暂不用设哨。 城内抽调五百精兵，伏守馆舍与内城要道。 严禁外人进出，随时待命配合蒯越与蔡夫人行动。)
Scene 7 · Jiangxia · rounds 3–10
Zhou Yu:
(At Jiangxia, Zhou Yu inspects the water fleet, counting each warship and its crew. Repair every broken oar and reinforce the mooring piles immediately. Arrange the navy for nearshore drills and test night fire attacks using oil and incendiary gear. Record all shortages and the supplies we will need to replenish.)

Zhou Yu:
(drafts a memorial to Sun Quan detailing the navy's current deficits and required supplies: ship repairs, oar replacements, mooring pile reinforcement, oil fuel and incendiary materials, craftsmen and timber, provisions, and newly recruited sailors. I will request Sun Quan to allocate official ships and materials and to dispatch craftsmen and reinforcements. Entrust this memorial to a messenger for immediate dispatch to Jianye and ask for a prompt reply so we may begin work at once.)

Zhou Yu:
(sends a messenger with the memorial and the supply list to ride day and night for Jianye. Present this to Sun Quan at once and urge him to send the official ships, craftsmen, and reinforcements without delay. You will take an escort of dozens and must return with a swift report.)

Zhou Yu:
(In Jiangxia, Zhou Yu organizes temporary repairs, requisitioning local craftsmen and timber for the work. Prioritize mending the damaged warships' oars and the mooring piles; set up repair shifts and issue necessary rations and tools. Keep the water forces training continuously, focusing on night fire attacks and coordinated fleet maneuvers. Log daily progress of repairs and drills to report to Jianye and stand ready for incoming reinforcements.)
周瑜:
(在江夏督察水师，清点战船與船員。 周瑜道：逐艘清点战船与在籍船员，不可含糊。 周瑜命令：检修橹桨与系泊连桩，务必完备。 周瑜下令：近岸操练水军，试验火攻用油脂与燃器材。 周瑜交代：将所有缺损与所需补给详记在案。)

周瑜:
(在江夏草拟呈报孙权的奏折，详列当前缺损。 周瑜念道：奏折须列明战船修缮、橹桨更换与连桩加固。 周瑜续道：并注明油脂燃料、燃器材、匠人及木料与粮饷。 周瑜补充：亦须新募水兵，请求孙权调拨官船与援军。 周瑜交代：命将此奏折付信使速送建业，恳请速复以便动工。)

周瑜:
(派信使携奏折與所需補給清單日夜兼程直赴建业。 周瑜吩咐：请孙权即刻过目，并速派官船、匠人及援军。 周瑜交代：护卫数十人随行，嘱信使务必速回报。)

周瑜:
(在江夏组织临时修缮，征集本地匠人与木料。 周瑜指示：优先修补受损战船的橹桨与系泊桩，成立修缮班次。 周瑜命令：配给必要粮饷与工具，确保修理不中断。 周瑜下令：水军持续操练，着重夜间火攻与舰队协同。 周瑜交代：每日记录修复与训练进度，备用回报建业并待援。)
Scene 8 · Jiangdong · rounds 3–21
Taishi Ci:
Mr. Zhang, I am Taishi Ci.
I've heard Sun Ce is brave; I wish to meet him.
I want to learn Jiangdong's situation and seek to join.
Where is Sun Ce now? Can you introduce me?

Zhang Zhao:
Taishi Ci, Sun Ce's entrusting is grave.
We must quickly discuss regency and protecting Sun Quan.
First I will hear your opinion.
Then we will assign duties and choose commanders.

Taishi Ci:
Mr. Zhang, this guardianship concerns all of Jiangdong.
We must stabilize military command and name regents and guardians.
I fought with Sun Ce at Shenting Ridge and am known for valor.
I offer myself: command troops and garrison key posts.
I will lead elite troops to guard the young lord.
My prestige can steady the people's hearts.
Please introduce me to Sun Ce or recommend me to Sun Quan.
I wish to state my intentions.
And discuss guarding and the distribution of military command.

Zhang Zhao:
Taishi Ci, I am glad to hear your willingness.
Our first duties are: hold military posts and protect the young lord.
Civilians must handle government affairs.
I propose you command the troops.
Garrison Shenting Ridge as primary and Kuaiji as backup.
You would lead the elite as Sun Quan's vanguard.
Yet Sun Ce's whereabouts are unknown; I ask your preference.
Do you prefer to serve near Sun Quan as an attendant guard?
Or lead the army holding the passes?
If you agree, I will introduce you or submit this plan.
I will then draft names and troop deployments.

Taishi Ci:
Mr. Zhang, I prefer to lead the troops and hold the posts.
Make Shenting Ridge and Kuaiji the primary strongholds.
I will lead my elite to garrison one and oversee nearby defenses.
I will leave a few personal guards beside Sun Quan and come when needed.
Please present this to Sun Quan or recommend it.
Draft the detailed troop assignments; I will obey orders.

Zhang Zhao:
Taishi Ci, I accept your pledge and propose specifics.
Appoint you commander; Shenting Ridge primary, Kuaiji backup.
If you choose Shenting Ridge, lead five hundred elite there.
Station two hundred at Kuaiji as a reserve.
Leave fifty guards with the young lord.
Civil officials will run the government; you hold military command.
Tell me three things.
One: which post — Shenting Ridge or Kuaiji?
Two: are the troop numbers sufficient or do you wish changes?
Three: can you depart now or must you wait to be introduced to Sun Quan?
Answer and I will submit the recommendation and finalize assignments.

Taishi Ci:
Mr. Zhang, I choose Shenting Ridge as my post.
I will lead five hundred elite to Shenting Ridge.
Pre-place two hundred at Kuaiji for mutual aid.
Leave fifty personal guards to serve the young lord.
If possible, add two hundred more at Shenting Ridge.
I can depart immediately to take command.
If I must be introduced to Sun Quan, I will wait.
Please present the recommendation and draft names.
Also draft the troop distribution; I will follow orders.

Zhang Zhao:
Taishi Ci, you choose to command; I restate the points.
Please state three things so I may submit.
One: is Shenting Ridge your final choice?
If not, would Kuaiji be acceptable?
Two: we propose five hundred at Shenting Ridge.
Two hundred at Kuaiji and fifty guards for the young lord.
Are these numbers acceptable, or do you wish adjustments?
Three: will you depart now or wait for introduction?
Also, have you chosen the personal guards, or shall we recommend them?
If you agree, I will present and secure appointments.

Taishi Ci:
Mr. Zhang, answers to the three points.
One: Shenting Ridge is my final choice.
Two: troop plan accepted — five hundred at Shenting Ridge.
Two hundred at Kuaiji for mutual aid.
Fifty guards to serve the young lord.
If possible, add two hundred more at Shenting Ridge as backup.
For formality, I prefer to be introduced to Sun Quan first.
If urgency demands, I can depart at once.
Personal guards: none chosen; I entrust selection to you.
Please present the recommendation and draft specific names.
Also draft the troop allocations; I will follow orders.

Zhang Zhao:
Taishi Ci, I accept your reply.
I will submit a recommendation to make you commander at Shenting Ridge.
Initial forces: five hundred there; add two hundred if allowed.
Kuaiji prepositioned with two hundred troops.
Fifty personal guards will remain with the young lord.
Please clarify three things.
One: if you have names for the personal guards, state them.
Two: will you depart now or wait to receive formal appointment?
Three: any officers you want under your command, or troop changes?
Once I have your answers I will submit.

Taishi Ci:
Mr. Zhang, answers to your three inquiries.
One: no personal guards named; I leave their selection to you.
Two: for legitimacy it is best to be introduced to Sun Quan first.
Yet if urgent military need exists, I can depart immediately.
Three: the forces - five hundred, two hundred, fifty - are acceptable.
If possible, add two hundred more at Shenting Ridge as backup.
Please recommend several experienced commanders I can trust.
Present the recommendation; I will follow orders and go.
太史慈:
张先生，我是太史慈。
闻孙策骁勇，今欲面见其人，打探江东形势并谋求投奔。
请问孙策现在在哪，能否引见？

张昭:
太史慈，孙策托孤之事重大。
我等须尽速商议辅政与守护孙权之策。
愿先听子意见，再共议分工与兵权人选。

太史慈:
张先生，关乎孙策托孤之事，实为江东大计。
首重稳固兵权、定辅政与守护人选，方能保全孙氏基业。
太史慈昔与孙策在神亭岭一战，素以武勇见称。
愿以身许国，督军戍守，率精锐镇要冲，护卫幼主，以威望稳人心。
恳请张先生引见孙策或荐於孙权，使某能面陈寸心，共商守护与兵权分配之策。

张昭:
太史慈，闻子愿以武辅国，张某深感欣慰。
当前首务当为：一、稳固兵权与要冲；二、护卫幼主以威望安人心；三、文官分掌朝政，确保政事运转。
拟议为：请子督军戍守要冲，可先以神亭岭、会稽为据点，并率精锐为护卫孙权之先锋。
由我与几位文臣负责辅政、断事与人事推荐，兵权以子为主，遇外患由子统帅迎敌。
然孙策行踪未定，暂难面见。
今问子更倾向哪一职——常驻孙权左右为近侍护卫，抑或领军驻守要冲以镇外患？
子若同意，我即引见于孙权或将此分工上陈，另拟具体人选与兵力配置，共商之。

太史慈:
张先生，某更倾向领军驻守要冲，以武力镇守江东外患。
建议以神亭岭、会稽为首要据点，某愿率精锐驻守其一并统领附近防务。
同时可留数名亲卫常侍左右，必要时亲临孙权左右为近侍护卫。
烦请张先生代为引见或上陈此议，并拟定具体人选与兵力配置，某当遵命赴任。

张昭:
太史慈，承子之忠勇。
张某拟议如下：令子为督军，主守要冲，神亭岭为首选，会稽为备选。
若子首选神亭岭，拟令子率精锐五百人驻守神亭岭，统领附近防务；在会稽预置精锐二百人以备互援；留亲卫五十人常侍幼主左右，必要时子亲临孙权左右为近侍护卫。
文官由我与数位同僚分掌朝政、人事与军需，兵权以子为主，遇外患由子统帅迎敌。
今请子定三事：一、首选据点（神亭岭或会稽）；二、子以为拟定兵力是否充足，或欲增减多少；三、子可否即刻赴任或等待引见孙权后署命？
子若允诺，张某即上陈荐介，以便速定分工并拟定详细人选与兵力调配。

太史慈:
张先生，承蒙擘画。
某首选神亭岭为据点，愿率精锐五百驻守神亭岭，预置会稽精锐二百以备互援，留亲卫五十常侍幼主左右。
若兵力允许，盼神亭岭再增二百人为后援。
关于赴任，某可即刻领命赴任以尽忠职，若需先引见孙权以正名分，某亦愿候命以示尊重。
劳请张先生上陈荐介并拟定具体人选与兵力调配，某当遵命赴行。

张昭:
今既倾向领军驻守要冲，张某据前所议拟定要点，特请子明言三事以便上陈荐介并尽速定分工：
一、首选据点是否最终定为神亭岭？若否，改为会稽可否？
二、拟令子率精锐五百驻神亭岭，会稽预置精锐二百，留亲卫五十常侍幼主；此兵力子以为可否，或欲增减几许？
三、子可否即刻赴任，抑或须待引见孙权受正式命令后方行？
另请告知亲卫人选是否已有所指，或愿由张某等荐介。
子若允诺，张某即呈表荐介，速定署命与人选，务使军政两端稳固。

太史慈:
张先生，答复三事如下：一、首选据点定为神亭岭。
二、兵力拟定：某率精锐五百驻神亭岭，会稽预置二百以备互援，亲卫五十常侍幼主；若兵力允许，望神亭岭再增二百为后援。
三、关于赴任：某可即刻领命赴任以尽忠职，然若需先引见孙权以正名分，某亦愿候命。
亲卫人选暂愿由张君等荐介，若张君已有所指，某即从命。
劳请张先生上陈荐介并拟定具体人选与兵力调配，某当遵命赴行。

张昭:
太史慈，承子允诺。
张某拟即呈表荐介：荐子为督军，驻神亭岭，初驻五百，若兵力允可增二百为后援；会稽预置二百互援；留亲卫五十常侍幼主。
烦请明示三事：一、亲卫人选若有名讳请具陈，若无可否俟张某等荐介？
二、子欲即刻出发，抑或待引见孙权受正式署命后为宜？
三、尚欲统帅之将或对兵力有何增减与禁忌？
张某得子回言即上呈。

太史慈:
张先生，答复三事如下：一、亲卫人选暂无人定，某愿委由张君等荐介；若张君已有所指，某即从命。
二、赴任事宜：为示名分与朝廷体例，某更宜先由张君上陈引见孙权以正署命；然若军务迫切，某可即刻率众赴任受令，以速稳边局。
三、关于部将与兵力：关于神亭岭主力五百、会稽预置二百、亲卫五十之拟定，某以为可行；若兵力允许，望神亭岭再增二百为后援。
统帅之将若需增减或有禁忌，恳请与张君共议并荐介几名有经验可托之将，以便署命后即行分配。
张君得此回言即请上呈荐介，某当听命赴行。
Scene 9 · Chenliu · rounds 4–4
Han Fu:
(dispatches a messenger to Chenliu to summon Xun Chen, Xin Ping, Guan Chun and the other strategists for a consultation. Summon Xun Chen, Xin Ping and Guan Chun to Chenliu. Also summon the other strategists to Chenliu. Decide whether to invite Yuan Shao to jointly run Jizhou.)
韩馥:
(他派遣信使赴邀荀谌、辛评、关纯等谋士到陈留相商是否请袁绍共理冀州事务。 预计回合 4 到位。)
Scene 10 · Liyang · rounds 4–4
Jia Xu:
(departs for Liyang; expected arrival in 24 rounds.)
贾诩:
