孙乾，并当即报首批征粮拟行路线、出发时刻及每批所需护送兵力，长途护送以每队一百人为起算，遇险增至二百人。
关羽，周仓、关平率机动队即刻开始首轮出城骚扰，速将机动队完整名单、首班出发确时與每五分钟轮换计划上呈。
关羽，并具体列出各城门與各粮仓留守人数，城内至少留半数守备或保持一支能迅速增援之预备队。
优先顺序不变：先保口粮與兵饷→补充远程弹药→甲胄修补。十分钟内回报三项要点，朕候命。

关羽:
糜竺、孙乾、陛下，我已收樊城逐仓初报并启动封存措施。
初报数为仓甲约六百石、仓乙约五百石、仓丙约四百石、仓丁约三百石、仓戊约二百石，合计约二千石。
糜竺请当面上呈逐仓签字原件與逐仓护库人员名单，含仓号、人员、职务与签名以便核对。
糜竺并请明示府主簿姓名與首批拟拨款总额，若需分仓先拨请指明各仓首拨额。
孙乾请回报盘点单预计到达时刻，若已有部分精数请先行呈交。
孙乾并请报首批征粮拟行路线、确切出发时刻与所需护送兵力；我建议首批按每队一百人为起算，遇险增至二百人。
若同意我之护送编制與路线建议，请回报需我立即抽调之护卫兵数與出发时刻，诸项速报。

孙乾:
关将军，为便于我即刻安排盘点单呈交护送并向陛下汇报，请速明确下列要项。
一、机动骚扰队完整名单除周仓、关平外各班领与主要将领姓名为何？首批确切人数是否约一百二十人？
请报首批确切出发时刻与轮换间隔。
二、请呈报各粮仓逐仓已封存数量与仓号，以及每处护库與管库人员名单与在位情况。
三、盘点单是否已到城内？若在路上请报预计到达时刻；若已到，呈交仅需五至十人短途护卫否？或需随盘单长途护送实物？
若需长途护送，请指明拟派护送队规模、拟行路线与预计出发时刻。
四、侦察掩护：可否即刻派一队掩护我出城侦察，可派兵数与可出发时刻为何？得报即我据旨调度并向陛下与糜竺呈报。

刘备:
诸将，速照如下分工速报以备朕裁示。
糜竺，将已封存之逐仓签字原件與逐仓护库人员名单当面上呈，并报出府主簿姓名與首批拟拨款总额與分配方案。
若可先行拨付，请注明先拨仓号与额度。
孙乾，若精盘已成，立刻当面将盘点原件交糜竺并同时呈朕；若在路上，立报预计到达确时。
并明示首批征粮拟行路线、出发确时與每批所需护送兵力，长途以每队一百人为起算，遇险增至二百人。
关羽，速报并呈机动队完整名单與轮换计划，且逐门逐仓列出留守人数，城内至少留半数守备或保持预备队。
若需朕即刻抽调增援护卫兵数，列明所需兵数與出发确时。十分钟内回报四项要点，朕候命。

糜竺:
陛下，呈樊城逐仓封存正式表，初报待孙乾呈盘点原件后更正定稿。
仓甲已封存约六百石，仓乙约五百石，仓丙约四百石，仓丁约三百石，仓戊约二百石。
合计初报约二千石，已按优先级封存并加固防护。
护库与签字：仓曹与孙乾已当面逐仓签字并逐项登记护库人员與签名。
盘点单原件与签署名单由孙乾当面呈交后，我将即刻把逐仓护库人员名单上呈陛下。
初拟拨付与处置建议：已依旨动用府库临拨银以保障一月口粮與兵饷。
首批拟拨款总额与府主簿姓名待与主簿核定后上报；若陛下许可，可先按优先序分仓先拨。
若需外运实物，长途护送以每队一百人为起算，遇险增至二百人；拟按仓甲→仓乙→仓丙优先外运。
请示陛下是否先行分仓拨发首批优先物资，若需我即刻外运，请指示优先仓号與拟出发兵力。

刘备:
糜竺，朕已受你之逐仓封存正式表，准此为初核并即刻处置。
一、同意按你建议优先外运，自仓甲起运，随后仓乙、仓丙为次。
糜竺即报建议首批外运数量、拟拨款总额及分配明细，並当面呈逐仓签字原件于朕。
二、护卫编制：长途外运以每队一百人为起算，遇险或路情不利则增至二百人。
糜竺與孙乾据此拟定护送批次與兵力需求并呈报。
孙乾，若精盘已成，立刻当面将原件交糜竺并同时呈朕；若在路上，立报预计到达确时。
并即报首批征粮或外运拟行路线、确切出发时刻与拟派护送兵力；若已有部分精数请先行呈交。
关羽，按旨配合护送，立即预备所需护卫兵力并报城内守备人数分配，若需增援须报明所需兵数与出发确时。
十分钟内回报三项，朕候命。

孙乾:
陛下，就樊城军需與对孙权外交，谨呈简报与建议。
当前急需与现状为封存合计约二千石粮，按日耗约二百石，可维持约十日。
库中军资可发约十五日兵饷；陛下已准临拨府库确保一月兵饷。
弓弩约一千副，箭约四万支；铠甲约六百副，完好约五百副。
结论：优先急需为一粮草二兵饷三弩弓与箭矢，甲胄修补为次。
已行与拟行后勤：已封存逐仓并由仓曹与我当面签字；府库得准临拨以保一月口粮與兵饷。
关于同孙权结盟之外交建议：宜速试探江东以争取实质援助，单凭樊城现有补给难持久。
建议以条件性结盟为目标，首要请求粮饷援助约四千石，并请求一段时间之兵饷支持。
次要请求为弩弓箭弹及若干水军或机动支援以牵制配合，条件谈判以援粮优先为主。
拟办与请示：请准我即刻率快马携行书出江东试探孙权，护卫以五至十骑为宜；出发前我将报使节姓名、出发确时與路线。
请示陛下示意对孙权之最低可接受条件，若准我出使我将携书求答复并带回盘点原件與孙权回馈。

刘备:
孙乾、糜竺、关羽，奉朕旨意命如下。
孙乾，朕准你即刻出使江东，携行书试探孙权态度。
使节护卫五至十骑为宜，由关羽负责抽调并押送；出发前须报使节姓名、出发确时與路线。
随行务必携带并当面呈朕所拟之底线书函，请求江东援粮四千石并请求一个月兵饷之银两与若干牵制或水师支援。
交涉以援粮为先，勿作不必要让步；出使期间不得妨碍城内盘点与侦察，有重大变故即刻回报。
糜竺，立刻报出府主簿姓名與首批拟拨款总额及分配明细，并当面呈逐仓签字原件于朕。
关羽，即刻预备五至十骑押送使节，并与孙乾会合，保证城内守备不减，至少留半数守备或一支预备队。
要点重申：优先顺序不变，诸事速行，出发与拨付等关键信息即时报于朕。

孙乾:
陛下，兹就樊城军需與江东试探呈即时汇报与请示。
逐仓初报为仓甲约六百、仓乙约五百、仓丙约四百、仓丁约三百、仓戊约二百，合计约二千石。
日耗约二百石，按此可维持约十日；兵饷库中可发约十五日，陛下已准临拨以保一月。
弓弩约一千副、箭约四万支；铠甲约六百副，完好约五百副，其余需修补。
已令仓曹与我当面封存并签字，糜竺與府主簿监督拨付并留账，关羽已率机动队扰敌并派轻骑侦察。
逐项精盘正由仓曹整理，预计约一刻钟内呈交，精盘后我将于十五分钟内呈交逐项精确数值与补给建议。
外交建议为先试探江东，首要请求粮料援助四千石与短期兵饷援助，次求弩弓箭与牵制配合。
拟办与请求陛下裁示：一请准臣出使，拟以七骑随行，出发前将报使节姓名、出发确时、路线與随行兵数。
二请示准在精盘到手前依陛下授权先行分批拨付优先项，若陛下欲待精盘后再拨付，臣即遵命。

关羽:
糜竺、孙乾、陛下，就糜竺所报逐仓初报回复并提出首批护送计划。
一、核实封存数为仓甲约六百、仓乙约五百、仓丙约四百、仓丁约三百、仓戊约二百，合计约二千石。
糜竺请当面呈交逐仓签字原件与逐仓护库人员名单，若有部分精盘亦请一并附上。
二、府主簿與拨款：糜竺请报出府主簿姓名與首批拟拨款总额，若需分仓先拨请指明各仓首拨额。
三、首批征粮外运拟案：建议自仓甲先运三百石，护送兵力起算一百人。
我将派一百名护卫并率二十骑轻骑作前探与掩护，拟出发时刻为十分钟后。
孙乾请即时回报盘点单到达确时或当面呈交原件，并确认首批外运路线是否可行。
糜竺在收验精盘并报出主簿與拨款明细后，我将立即装运并护送首批外运。

刘备:
关羽、糜竺、孙乾，已悉并准此执行。
一、首批外运准自仓甲先行外运三百石。
二、关羽，准你率一百名护卫押运，另派二十骑为前探與掩护。
出发确时暂定为十分钟后，如孙乾有路况异议立即回报并改定确时。
三、孙乾，立刻当面将盘点原件交糜竺，若在路上报预计到达确时，并即时报首批外运路线與出发确时。
四、糜竺，请当面呈逐仓签字原件並报出府主簿姓名與首拨用于本次三百石之运费與兵饷明细，即刻落实拨付并留账。
五、城内守备不得削弱，至少留半数守备或保持一支能迅速增援之预备队。
诸事速行，十分钟内回报三项要点，朕候命。

孙乾:
关将军，已悉你先行出城与首轮机动队出发之报，现就若干事项拟定请速回确认。
一、机动骚扰队已记周仓为队长、关平为副将，首批约一百二十人即刻出城，每五分钟一班轮换。
请随后立呈完整名单，周仓、关平之外各班领與主要将领姓名及各班出发确时。
二、粮仓封存与护库人员：请当面将每仓护库人员名单與已封存逐仓签字原件交糜竺并抄送我。
若已有部分精数亦请先行呈交并报到达时间。
三、盘点单呈交与护送兵力决定：若仅城内短途呈交，准以五至十人短途护卫。
若须随盘单外运实物，首批按议定由仓甲先运三百石，护送兵力以一百人为起算。
关将军若同意由你统领该护送队，请报是否由关羽统领，护送出发确时，及是否额外派二十骑前探。
四、侦察掩护与会合：我将出城侦察，望示能否派队掩护，报兵数與可出发时刻，以便我与之会合。
务必速报机动队完整名单、各仓护库人员名单與逐仓签字原件到达时间，以及对首批外运与护送布置之同意与确时。

孙乾:
关将军，已悉并回报确认与指示如下，请速补正并呈交所需单证。
一、首批外运核准，自仓甲先运三百石，护送以一百人为一队，请指明统领姓名或准由关羽统领。
并请回报确切出发时刻，建议另派二十骑轻骑为前探，烦请回示是否同意并指派领队。
二、机动骚扰队周仓为队长、关平为副将，首批约一百二十人出城，每五分钟轮换，请随后立呈完整名单。
三、粮仓护卫與签字原件请当面将各仓护库人员名单與逐仓签字原件交糜竺并抄送我，若有部分精数先行呈交并报到达时间。
四、城内守备请明列各城门與各粮仓留守人数，须至少留半数守备或保持一支能迅速增援之预备队。
五、侦察掩护与会合：我将出城侦察，请确认可否立即派队掩护并报兵数与可出发时刻，以便我立刻安排会合。
得你确报我即刻按旨调度并向陛下呈报当前已执行与拟执行事项。
Scene 32 · Xuchang · rounds 42–61
Xun Yu:
Le Jin, report in writing to me, Zhang Liao, and Cheng Yu the following at once.
Give the number of garrison infantry available at each gate and camp, and name their posts and commanding officers.
Inventory each granary, main and satellite—state stored grain and cloth, number of usable grain sacks, and any shortages.
List current military equipment—crossbows, bows, arrows—and note any shortfalls.
Give names and current coordinates of convoy guards, sentries, and liaison officers.
Detail day-and-night guard and inner/outer sentry arrangements, who mans them, and the rotation schedule.
If shortages exist, itemize required reinforcements and rations and an estimated arrival time. His Majesty demands a written reply within one hour.
Immediately post elite troops day and night to guard the main granary, guard against internal collusion and private transport; upon receipt I will coordinate supplements. Report anything heard.

Zhang Liao:
Le Jin, I have your reply. Report at once the detailed numbers of the forces you command and the garrison dispositions.
State the number of garrison infantry available at each of the south, north, east, and west gates and each camp, and give day-and-night rotation schedules.
Give current stock and shortages of the grain and military stores you oversee.
Provide names and current coordinates of each unit's liaison officers.
If external aid or supplies are needed, report required troop numbers, material quantities, sources, and estimated arrival times. Send the initial report quickly.

Cheng Yu:
Xu Gong has moved the handover to tomorrow at 3:45 p.m. at the inn.
Which time shall you follow? Will you still collect at midnight tonight, or shift to tomorrow at 3:45 p.m.? Report quickly.

Yu Jin:
Generals and ministers, I have Le Jin's report and news of three-route departures.
For unified control, each of you must present: actual numbers of garrison infantry at the south, north, east, and west gates, and confirm whether forty crossbowmen at each embrasure are in place.
State the number of troops available for patrol and reconnaissance, each unit's assigned routes, and current coordinates.
Report each unit's remaining grain and military stores and shortages; Le Jin will submit an inventory and mark estimated resupply times.
Give the names of each unit's liaison officers.
State city reserve elite numbers and deployment on key routes; Xiahou Dun will confirm city dispositions. Report within one hour; if engaged, notify Commander Zhang immediately.

Zhang Liao:
All present, Le Jin has reported three routes departing.
Submit at once to the commander: the number of garrison infantry available at south, north, east, and west gates and each camp, including rotation schedules and specific posts.
List current stocks of grain and military stores for city garrison, patrols, and the three reconnaissance routes, noting shortages.
Give the names and current coordinates of each unit's liaison officer.
If you require external aid or supplies, detail needed troop numbers, material quantities, sources, and estimated arrival times.
If any suspect internal collaborators appear, detain them and report names and circumstances. Xiahou Dun, Xiahou Yuan, Yu Jin, Le Jin, Xu Shu, Xun Yu, and Cheng Yu report first—send your initial reports promptly.

Xiahou Dun:
Yu Jin, I acknowledge your report and will act per council orders.
Immediately present the following details for the command's coordination: garrison infantry numbers at south, north, east, and west gates, and the number of crossbowmen at each embrasure.
State numbers available for patrols and reconnaissance, each unit's current coordinates and planned routes.
List current grain and military stores and shortages, and mark assigned convoy guards, routes, and escort numbers.
Give each unit's liaison officer name and contact method.
Report the city elite reserve size, deployment on key routes, and assembly points. Be swift, accurate, and detailed: initial report within one hour; if engaged, notify Commander Zhang immediately. Detain any suspect persons for interrogation.

Xu Shu:
Generals, present these details so we can update the initial report and sentry dispositions from Le Jin's report.
State the number of garrison infantry at the south, north, east, and west gates; if split by camp, name the parent camp.
Report the actual numbers available for patrol and reconnaissance and each unit's current coordinates; note if units have left the city and give their coordinates.
Give each unit's remaining grain and military stores and shortages; Le Jin, attach inventory sheets and mark estimated resupply arrival times.
Provide each unit's liaison officer name and current location.
State how many scouts have been sent and their reconnaissance directions and initial findings. Reply within one hour; if engaged, report immediately.

Xun Yu:
Commander Zhang, generals: I have noted your reports.
For coordination, present to the command and to Cheng Yu and me the following items promptly.
Give exact numbers of garrison infantry at the south, north, east, and west gates and each camp, with day-and-night rotation schedules.
State whether each embrasure has forty crossbowmen in place.
Report the three reconnaissance routes and patrols, each unit's available numbers, planned routes, and current coordinates.
Inventory each granary, main and satellite, with stored grain and cloth, usable grain sacks, shortages, and estimated resupply times.
List current military implements—crossbows, bows, arrows—and any shortfalls.
Give liaison officer names and current coordinates for every unit.
Detain and report any suspected internal collaborators with names and reasons.
If you need external aid, list required troops and material sources and estimated arrival times. Reply within one hour. Cheng Yu and I will collate these into a Xuchang defense draft to present to the commander and His Majesty.

Xiahou Dun:
All present, by Commander Zhang's order, submit the following initial report to the command.
Give numbers of garrison infantry available at south, north, east, and west gates, and name crossbowmen assigned at each embrasure with day-and-night rotation schedules.
State numbers available for patrols and reconnaissance, each unit's current coordinates and planned routes.
List grain and military stores on hand and shortages, and note convoy guards, escort numbers, routes, and estimated resupply times.
Provide liaison officer names and contact details.
Give the size of the city's elite reserve, its deployment on key routes and assembly points. Be swift, accurate, detailed: initial report within one hour; if engaged, notify Commander Zhang and the court. Detain any suspect persons for questioning.

Cheng Yu:
Le Jin, Cheng Gong asks again: Xu Gong has moved the handover to tomorrow at 3:45 p.m. at the inn.
Will you follow the original midnight plan and retrieve at midnight, or shift to tomorrow at 3:45 p.m.? If you go at midnight, take the letter then and keep silent on the road; if you move it to 3:45 p.m., follow Xu Gong's instruction and report back first. Reply quickly.

Xun Yu:
Xiahou Dun, I accept your report and orders are as follows.
Recheck immediately the four gates and each embrasure's crossbowmen numbers and present the table to the command.
You will command inner and outer guards and lead the city's elite reserve to hold passes and key routes; if engaged, counterattack or hold terrain until relief arrives.
Coordinate instant reporting channels with Xiahou Yuan, Le Jin, and Yu Jin; require sunrise and sunset routine reports and immediate messaging if engaged.
Detain any suspected internal collaborators and bring them in for interrogation; within half an hour submit a written report of your deployable garrison infantry numbers, crossbowmen, and current grain and military stores with shortages and required supplements and estimated arrival times.
Cheng Yu and I will collate these into the Xuchang defense draft. Act swiftly.

Xiahou Dun:
Xun Yu, I accept your instructions and authorize you and Cheng Yu to collate the Xuchang defense draft at once.
List in order the garrison infantry numbers at the south, north, east, and west gates, each embrasure's crossbowmen and the day-and-night rotation table.
List numbers available for patrols and the three reconnaissance routes, each unit's current coordinates and planned routes.
Give inventories of grain and military stores and shortages, note convoy guards and estimated resupply arrival times.
Provide liaison officer names and coordinates and state the city's elite reserve numbers, deployments, and assembly points.
Detain any suspect internal collaborators and report them. Prepare a written initial draft within half an hour to the command, copied to me and Commander Zhang for inclusion in the defense plan.

Xiahou Yuan:
Commander, Commander Zhang, His Majesty, I submit the initial report as ordered.
Gate garrisons temporarily available for redeployment: south gate about 160 men including 40 rotating crossbowmen; north gate about 160 with 40 crossbowmen; east gate about 160 with 40; west gate about 160 with 40. Each gate will retain embrasure crossbowmen and night rotations.
Patrol and reconnaissance: my force of light cavalry totals 300, divided into three routes—Route One led by Xiahou Yuan: 100 men, currently hidden on high ground outside Chenliu; Route Two led by Le Jin: 100 men, hidden in the woods south of Puyang; Route Three led by Yu Jin: 100 men, at the Boling ferry northwest, ready. City reserve and guarding key passes about 40 men under Xiahou Dun.
Grain and stores: my command can sustain operations and reconnaissance for several days with accompanying rations. We have about twenty light crossbows and sufficient arrows; shortages are heavy crossbows and several draft horses. Le Jin will compile a full camp inventory for supplementation.
Liaison officers and coordinates: Route One liaison Zhao Guang at the Chenliu hidden high ground; city liaison Zhang Lin at the Xuchang command; Route Two and Route Three liaisons are with their leaders and maintain day-and-night contact with the command.
Scouts and initial findings: about twelve scouts sent toward Chenliu, Runan, and the north bank of the Yellow River. Initial report: no main enemy force encountered at our positions; we found traces of supply carts and captured and processed several small supply wagons. No large enemy hostiles nearby.
Request command instruction: may I escort the captured supplies back for inspection, or first present the evidence to the command?

Cheng Yu:
Xiahou Yuan, approved: escort the seized supplies back and present them to the command for inspection.
Take twenty riders as an escort and leave the remainder to conceal and stand ready for reconnaissance; do not move deep into unsecured territory to avoid an ambush.
Choose secure minor roads for the escort and have the liaison officer state an estimated arrival time. Report exact current coordinates, planned return time, and the escort roster at once. If you meet superior enemy strength, preserve your force and withdraw to strong ground, then send word.

Emperor Xian of Han:
Xiahou Yuan, Commander Zhang, Le Jin, Xiahou Dun, Yu Jin, and all generals: I have read Xiahou Yuan's initial report.
You are permitted to continue reconnaissance and to escort seized supplies back, but do not pursue the enemy main force; if you meet heavy resistance withdraw to strong ground and notify the command and me immediately.
Seized supplies are to be escorted by the liaison officer to the command's designated granary; Le Jin will receipt, record, secure evidence, and report promptly. Commander Zhang will ensure each gate holds to initial reported strengths—about 160 men at south, north, east, and west, forty crossbowmen at each embrasure, and about forty elite reserve in the city. Report shortages with required troops, arms, rations, and estimated arrival times.
Xiahou Yuan, Le Jin, and Yu Jin must, within one hour, submit detailed lists of each gate's garrison, patrols, and reconnaissance including coordinates and liaison names, and current grain and military shortfalls. Continue sunrise and sunset reports; if engaged, report at once.

Zhang Liao:
Xiahou Yuan, I have received your initial report and approve your actions with these conditions.
Continue reconnaissance and seizing supplies, but do not enter enemy rear or engage suspected main forces; if the situation turns unfavorable, withdraw to defensible terrain.
If captured goods are portable, escort them in small detachments to the command for inspection with a full list; if too bulky or too risky, preserve only evidentiary items such as ledgers, seals, and military marks and destroy the rest.
Each return report must record quantity and type of seized supplies, disposition of the goods, prisoners and casualties, coordinates, and your intended next move. If you need escort troops or draft animals, state the numbers required and estimated arrival time.
Liaison officers must maintain day-and-night contact with the command and sound the alarm for urgent messages. I await your detailed initial report and coordinates. Conduct operations cautiously and do not reveal your dispositions.

Xiahou Dun:
Your Majesty, I report we have implemented the ordered defenses and dispatched the required reconnaissance.
We have sealed outer gates, instituted day-and-night crossbow rotation, and reinforced the walls and outer moat.
Three routes of light cavalry have left the city: Xiahou Yuan, Le Jin, and Yu Jin each lead one hundred riders, concealed nearby and standing by; they will report at sunrise and sunset and notify immediately upon engagement and withdraw to strong ground if necessary.
The city's reserve elite of about forty men remain under my command to guard key passes and important ferry points.
Le Jin is auditing grain and military stores; initial report shows supplies for several days, about twenty light crossbows, and shortages in heavy crossbows and several draft horses; I have ordered swift replenishment.
Reconnaissance has seized traces and some small supply wagons; evidence is being escorted to the command for recording and accounting.
Each gate and unit has been ordered to submit an initial report including coordinates, liaison names, available troop numbers and shortages; we will compile and submit within one hour. We detain any suspects for interrogation. I await Your Majesty's orders for any troop movements or adjustment.

Xiahou Yuan:
Cheng Yu, I acknowledge and submit the precise coordinates for our three routes.
Route One under Xiahou Yuan is concealed on the high ground outside Chenliu, about three li southeast of Chenliu.
Route Two under Le Jin is concealed in the woods south of Puyang, about two li southwest of Puyang.
Route Three under Yu Jin is at the Boling ferry, northwest about one li. The city reserve of about forty men stands at the Xuchang command awaiting orders.
For the seized supplies I propose to抽二十骑 as an escort led by Zhao Guang, using forces drawn from Route One and the city reserve: fifteen from Route One and five from the city reserve, preserving reconnaissance strength.
The escort will avoid main roads and follow minor paths from Chenliu south to Xuchang, estimated travel time about two hours; we can dispatch immediately. Please authorize the twenty-rider escort and the proposed route, or order adjustments.

Cheng Yu:
Le Jin: regarding retrieving Xu's mother's letter at Xuchang East tonight at midnight, which time shall you follow?
Will you proceed at midnight as originally planned, or shift the handover to tomorrow at 3:45 p.m. at the inn? Report at once.
荀彧:
乐进，奉陛下及吾令，速将下列逐项明报并书面呈于我、张辽与程昱。
请将各门各营可出动之守城步卒数，并注明驻点与隶属将领。
请报各粮仓主仓与分储之谷帛实存数、可用粮袋数及短缺项。
请明列现有军器如弩、弓、箭等之数量与短缺项。
将护运队、哨位与联络官姓名及当前驻点坐标明示。
详述已施行之日夜把守与内外哨卡布置并附轮换表。
若有短缺，逐项列明所需援军與粮饷数目及预计到援时点。
陛下限令一时辰内回奏，现令汝即刻派精兵昼夜把守主仓，严防内应与私运。
所报一到，吾即统筹拨补，所闻即奏。

张辽:
乐进，已悉汝复命，速将你所督之部队与守备详细数目上报。
请报南北东西各门及各营可出动守城步卒数，并列明昼夜轮换班次与驻守位置。
请报你所督管之粮草与军器现存量与短缺项。
请列各队联络官姓名与当前驻点坐标。
若需外援或补给，详报所需兵数、物资数量、来源与预计到援时点。
首报速来，所闻即奏。

程昱:
徐公已改为明日午后三刻于馆驿交接，汝今按何时为准？
仍赴今夜子时，或改明日午后三刻？请速回禀。

于禁:
诸位将军、卿等，已悉乐进回报与三路出征，现为便于统筹请速呈明细。
请报四门各可出动守城步卒实数，并确认各垛口弩手是否已达四十人。
请报可用于巡逻与侦骑之兵数、各队已派路线与当前驻点坐标。
各队粮饷与军器余量与短缺项请详列，乐进并将提交盘点表与预计到援时点。
请报各队联络官姓名，城内精锐预备队人数与要道部署由夏侯惇确认。
一时辰内呈报，遇敌即刻传讯张都督并速报朝廷，张都督总摄全局。

张辽:
诸位，乐进已复命三路出发，今令各将诸卿即刻呈报下列明细于都督部。
请报四门及各营可出动守城步卒数，含昼夜轮换班次与每处驻守位置。
请报各队现有粮草与军器存量，并列明短缺项。
请报各队联络官姓名与当前驻点坐标，若需外援详报所需兵数物资与预计到援时点。
遇可疑内应即行收押并将人名与情况上奏，夏侯惇等先行首报，首报速来。

夏侯惇:
于禁，承你禀，依军议即刻呈下列明细以便都督部统筹。
请报四门各可出动守城步卒数，并注明各垛口现配弩手人数。
请报可用于巡逻与侦骑之兵数、各队现驻点坐标与拟分配路线。
各处粮饷与军器余量与短缺项并标明已布护运队、路线与护卫人数。
请报各队联络官姓名及联络方式，城内精锐预备队人数与把守要道部署与候命地点。
务求速、准、详：一时辰内呈初报，遇敌即刻传讯张都督并速报朝廷。

徐庶:
诸将速呈下列明细，以便据乐进所报立即更新初报与哨位布置。
请报四门各可出动守城步卒实数，若分营请注明所属营名。
请报各自可出动巡逻与侦骑实数，并报当前驻点坐标或出城驻点坐标。
请报各队现有粮草与军器余量及短缺项，乐进请附盘点表并标明预计补给到达时点。
请报每队联络官姓名与现驻坐标，已派斥候数与侦察方向亦请呈报。
请在一时辰内回报，遇敌即刻速报。

荀彧:
张都督、诸位将军，悉诸公所陈，现令速将下列逐项明报呈于都督部并报于吾与程昱。
请将四门及各营可出动守城步卒实数并附昼夜轮换班次呈报。
请核实各垛口弩手到位人数，注明每处是否达四十人。
请报三路侦骑与巡逻队各队可出动人数、拟定路线与当前驻点。
请报各粮仓主仓與分储谷帛实存数、可用粮袋数、短缺项及预计到援时点。
请报现有军器如弩弓箭之数量与短缺项，及各队联络官姓名與当前驻点坐标。
若有可疑内应即行收押并报明人名与情由，若需外援详列所需兵力與物资来源与预计到达时点。
限一时辰内回奏，吾与程昱将统筹汇总各份，拟入许昌防务初稿，速行，所闻即奏。

夏侯惇:
诸位在座，奉张都督之令速将下列初报呈于都督部以便统筹。
请报四门各可出动守城步卒实数，并注明各垛口现配弩手人数与昼夜轮换班次。
请报可用于巡逻与侦骑之兵数、各队现驻点坐标与拟分配路线。
请报各处粮饷与军器余量与短缺项，并标明护运队、护卫人数、路线与预计到援时点。
请报各队联络官姓名与联络方式，城内精锐预备队人数、把守要道部署與候命地点。
务求速、准、详：一时辰内呈初报，遇敌即时传讯张都督并速报朝廷。

程昱:
乐进，程公再问：徐公已改为明日午后三刻于馆驿交接，汝今按何时为准？
若仍赴今夜子时，务必按原定子时取回并路上戒言；若改明日午后三刻，届时按徐公旨行并先回稟。
速回禀。

荀彧:
夏侯惇，承你回报，所陈可曜，现依卿所述令如下。
即刻复核四门及各垛口弩手到位人数与昼夜轮换表，并将表文呈都督部。
你督内外卫并统领城内精锐预备队，坚守隘口与要道，遇敌即行顽抗或固守待援。
与夏侯渊、乐进、于禁三路联络官立刻通合回报渠道，务求日出日落例报、遇敌即刻传讯。
若发觉可疑内应，先行收押带回审问并速报都督部。
请在半刻内书面呈报你部可出动守城步卒实数、弩手人数及现有粮饷与军器余缺并标注候补与预计到援时点。

夏侯惇:
荀公，承你所陈，准你与程昱即刻统筹汇总许昌防务初稿。
请逐项列明四门守城步卒实数、各垛口弩手人数与昼夜轮换表。
请列出可用于巡逻与三路侦骑之兵数、各队现驻点坐标与拟行路线。
请列各处粮饷与军器存量与短缺项，并标注护运队与预计到援时点。
请报各队联络官姓名与现驻坐标，城内精锐预备队人数、把守要道部署與候命地点。
若有可疑内应即行收押带回并速报都督部，半刻内呈书面初稿于都督部并抄送吾与张都督。

夏侯渊:
都督部、张都督、陛下、诸位，依令呈报初报如下。
四门可出动守城步卒暂可调出以充实时防需，各门约可出动守卒一百六十人，垛口弩手约四十人。
我麾下轻骑合计三百人，分为三路，各路实出一百骑。
路一由我自领，现驻陈留郊外隐蔽高地待机；路二乐进领，驻濮阳南侧掩蔽林；路三于禁领，驻博陵渡口西北待机。
城内预备并把守要道约四十人，由夏侯惇督领。
我部粮草可维持数日，随队口粮已计，现配轻弩约二十架，箭矢充足，短缺重弩与数匹辎重马。
我方联络官赵广驻陈留郊外隐蔽高地，城内联络官张临在许昌都督部，路二路三联络官随各路首领昼夜直通都督部。
已派斥候约十二人分向陈留、汝南及黄河北岸侦察，抵驻点时未遇敌主力，截获并处理若干补给小车，暂无大规模敌兵接近。
请都督与陛下裁示我可否继续深入查证并押回缴获物，或先将补给证据呈送都督部审核？

程昱:
夏侯渊，承阅，关于你所缴获补给，准你押回并优先呈送都督部审核。
抽二十骑为护运队押送，余队就近隐蔽驻点戒备侦察，切勿深入无保障地带以免被诱敌。
押运路线上择牢靠小道并由联络官报明预计到达时点，速复当前驻点精确坐标、拟押回时间与护运队号目。
若遇敌势大，先保全兵力退守坚固地形并速传信。

汉献帝:
夏侯渊、张都督、乐进、夏侯惇、于禁、诸将，朕已悉夏侯渊初报。
准汝等继续在现驻点深入侦探并押回所缴补给，但不得擅自深追敌主力。
若遇敌重兵，速退守坚固地形并即刻传讯都督部与朕。
所缴补给由联络官押运至都督部指定仓库，乐进负责点收立账、保全证据并速上奏。
张都督督促四门按初报人数严守，南北东西各约一百六十人，垛口弩手各四十人，城内精锐预备约四十人。
若有短缺速报并列明所需兵力、军器与粮饷及预计到援时点。
夏侯渊、乐进、于禁一时辰内将各门守备、巡逻與侦骑逐项明细含驻点与联络官姓名坐标及当前粮饷军器余缺呈都督部，所获情报仍日日晨暮例报，遇敌即刻速报。

张辽:
夏侯渊，承汝首报，准汝按下令继续查证处置所获，但谨守要点。
可继续截获补给，然不可深入敌后或与疑为主力之部队硬拼，遇敌势不利即刻撤回据险。
缴获物若轻便可小股押回都督部审核，若过于繁重或押运风险大，务必先截留账册印信等证据，其余可毁以绝敌用。
每次回报须记载缴获补给量与品类、去向、俘虏与伤亡数、驻点坐标與拟行下一步意图。
如需押运援军或辎重护送，详陈所需兵数與预计到援时点，联络官昼夜直通都督部遇急情立刻鸣号传讯。慎行勿露行踪。

夏侯惇:
陛下，禀：末将已按议布防并督令落实。
已即刻封固外门，垛口弩手昼夜轮换，城墙与外壕加固。
分三路轻骑出城侦察，夏侯渊、乐进、于禁各率一队，实出各一百骑，已就近隐蔽驻点待机并按日出日落回报。
城内留守精锐约四十人由末将督领把守要道与重要渡口。
乐进正清点粮饷与军器，初报粮草可维数日，轻弩约二十架，短缺重弩與数匹辎重马，已令速补。
侦察已截获若干补给小车痕迹并押回证据，联络官正押运至都督部点收立账。
各门与各队已被令呈初报含驻点坐标联络官姓名可出兵数與缺项，一时辰内将汇总上呈都督部，凡遇可疑者即行收押带回审问。

夏侯渊:
程公，承阅，现具复如下我部三路驻点坐标。
路一由我自领，驻陈留郊外隐蔽高地，陈留东南约三里；
路二乐进领，驻濮阳南侧掩蔽林，濮阳西南约二里；路三于禁领，驻博陵渡口西北约一里。
城内精锐预备约四十人在许昌都督部待命。
关于所缴获补给，拟抽二十骑为护运队押送都督部，由赵广领队，路一出十五骑、城内抽五骑混编。
押运路线避主道沿小路由陈留向南回许昌，预计行程约二时辰可达，即刻可发，余队继续就近隐蔽驻点戒备侦察。
请程公与都督裁示准予按此抽二十骑押运缴获物回都督部否，若需改派护运官或调整出发时刻属下随令调整并即刻回报。

程昱:
乐进，今夜子时于许昌城东取徐母家书之事，今以何时为准？
仍按子时取回，还是改为明日午后三刻于馆驿交接？请速回禀。
Scene 33 · Jiangdong · rounds 43–62
Cheng Pu:
Grand Tutor Zhang, Cheng Pu reports.
I recommend Han Dang and Huang Gai as Kuaiji naval sub-commanders; Han Dang to oversee drills and patrols, Huang Gai to manage shipbuilding, fire attacks, and escorting grain convoys.
I can bring 500 elite armored men and more than ten small boats, ready to assemble and depart in three days; to expand to 1,000 would take five to seven days.
If relying on prefectural levies, I suggest a baseline defence of 2,000 garrison troops and thirty main warships to secure the coast and grain transport.
On order of appointment, it is proper you present us to Sun Quan for commission; if operations are urgent, you may submit the petition and issue a travel pass and I will move once ordered.
Please advise the departure date and issue the travel pass; if the force is five hundred I will set out in three days, otherwise I will await your command.
Cheng Pu swears to serve the Sun household with loyalty.

Taishi Ci:
Mr. Zhang, I reply and ask you to clarify several points.
I leave the choice of my personal guard entirely to you and your recommendations; I will accept the names you propose.
On forces: I can gather five hundred elite men within three days; if the court approves an increase to seven hundred, I will need five to seven days to assemble them.
On timing I prefer you present me to Sun Quan to receive proper commission, but if urgent you may submit the petition and issue orders and I will depart on command.
Please tell me when you will submit the petition, when I might be presented to Sun Quan or see Sun Ce, or, if we must depart, please grant a travel pass and name the departure date; I will be ready upon orders.

Zhang Zhao:
Taishi Ci, Cheng Pu, I intend to present the petition at once; the proposed contents are as follows.
First, recommend Taishi Ci as commander, to be posted at Shenting Ridge with an initial five hundred men; if permitted by the court, request an additional two hundred as reserve; place two hundred at Kuaiji for mutual support; retain fifty personal guards to attend the young lord.
Second, propose Cheng Pu to lead the naval contingent of five hundred (expandable to one thousand with five to seven days' preparation); nominate Han Dang as naval deputy to oversee drills and patrol, and Huang Gai to supervise shipbuilding, fire attacks, and convoy protection.
Third, if Taishi Ci already has preferred names for his guard or Kuaiji subordinates, supply them; if not, I will nominate several candidates for inclusion in the petition and await the commission.
Fourth, specify the confirmed number of troops accompanying him (if five hundred, three days to assemble; if expanded to one thousand, five to seven days), and whether he insists on being presented by me before departure or will move on orders.
I will present the petition and prepare a travel pass and departure date once I receive your replies so that orders may be issued without delay.

Taishi Ci:
Mr. Zhang, I have received your draft recommendations and concur in naming Han Dang as naval deputy and Huang Gai to oversee shipbuilding, fire attacks, and convoy protection; if you have a better nominee I will follow your judgement.
Please tell me when you will submit the petition and when I might be presented to Sun Quan or see Sun Ce; if we must leave early, please issue a travel pass and name the departure date.
On forces I can gather five hundred in three days; to reach seven hundred will take five to seven days. I prefer to be presented first to receive commission, but will move immediately on orders.

Zhang Zhao:
Cheng Pu, Taishi Ci, I plan to present the petition to our lord tomorrow; prepare your forces accordingly.
Each of you, confirm whether you insist on being presented first to receive formal commission or whether I should submit the petition and issue travel papers so you can depart immediately.
Cheng Pu is confirmed to lead five hundred, ready in three days; expanding to one thousand requires five to seven days; Taishi Ci's guard and subordinate nominations will be included in the petition.
If our lord approves I will immediately issue a travel pass and set the departure date; if he prefers to receive them first I will arrange an audience in due course.
If either of you has objections or wishes to add names, troop counts, or a departure date, reply promptly.

Cheng Pu:
Grand Tutor Zhang, Cheng Pu reports in obedience to orders.
I will obey and now prepare five hundred elite armored men and more than ten small boats, ready to assemble and depart in three days; to expand to one thousand I require five to seven days, awaiting your instruction.
I still prefer to be presented by you to the lord to receive formal commission; if operations demand haste, submit the petition and issue a travel pass and I will march on your command.
Please indicate the travel pass and departure date; Cheng Pu pledges to execute orders and serve faithfully.

Zhang Zhao:
(inner monologue: (thinking): To Commander Sun Ce: the border is unsettled and must be secured; I humbly submit this petition and proposal. I propose Taishi Ci as overall commander, to be posted at Shenting Ridge with an initial garrison of five hundred elite troops; if the court permits, grant an additional two hundred as reserves. Arrange two hundred troops pre-placed at Kuaiji for mutual reinforcement, and leave fifty personal guards constantly to attend the young lord so internal and external security are both shored up. I propose Cheng Pu to command the naval forces accompanying the operation, five hundred men initially, expandable to one thousand by usual procedure; expansion will require about five to seven days to prepare. Within Cheng Pu's command nominate Han Dang as naval deputy to supervise daily drills, patrols, and combat command; nominate Huang Gai to oversee shipbuilding, fire attack preparations, and protection of convoys and stores. I respectfully request the court's approval and issuance of a travel pass and a departure date to enable timely assembly: five hundred men can be ready in three days; should we expand to seven hundred or one thousand, allow five to seven days for full preparation. On the matter of personal guards and Kuaiji subordinates, I offer to recommend several names for inclusion in the petition, or the lord may appoint them directly according to his preference. Should the lord approve, please issue the travel pass and set a departure date so we may proceed to steady the frontier; if the lord prefers to receive these men first, please indicate a suitable audience day for their formal presentation. I submit a draft travel-pass outline and notes for action: the assembly points will be the county camps under this prefecture; Taishi Ci and Cheng Pu will gather their forces at their own camp gates and report numbers three days before departure. Logistics and readiness notes: if five hundred is the baseline, three days suffice to assemble; if expanding to seven hundred or one thousand, allow five to seven days and ensure arms, boats, and provisions are prepared simultaneously. Ship and equipment notes: Cheng Pu's main warboats and escort vessels will accompany the force; Huang Gai shall supervise repairs and prepare fire weapons; inspect rudders, oars, sails, and all essential fittings before embarkation. Supplies: issue three days' marching rations initially, designate resupply points and convoy routes, and have Kuaiji pre-place two hundred troops and local grain reserves with county cooperation. Communications and security: establish beacon and watch posts, unify military orders from the commander and main general, and set messenger protocols; Taishi Ci's fifty personal guards shall be named and assigned duties, with small escort detachments posted along the route. Emergency measures: if the enemy moves or roads are blocked, the commander may deploy the Kuaiji two hundred as immediate reinforcements; major incidents must be reported to the lord without delay. Suggested departure timings: five hundred men—depart within three days of the order; expanding to seven hundred or one thousand—allow five to seven days for complete preparation. Proposed nominations and placeholders for the lord's decision: Commander at Shenting Ridge—Taishi Ci; Naval main command—Cheng Pu with Han Dang as deputy; Shipbuilding, fire attack, and convoy protection—Huang Gai. Reserve slots: two to three posts for Kuaiji's pre-placed two hundred, fifty slots for Taishi Ci's personal guard to be named jointly by Zhang and the two commanders or by the lord, and additional deputy and garrison posts to be filled by the lord or by our recommendations. If desired, I will prepare a detailed list of nominees and a formal travel-pass document for the lord's signature and immediate issuance.)

Cheng Pu:
(orders in Jiangdong the preparation of five hundred elite armored troops and the assembly of more than ten small boats. He summons shipwrights to repair warships and to prepare rudders, oars, sails, and other essential fittings, outfits the troops and readies their gear, and directs all to be ready to depart within three days.)

Zhang Zhao:
Cheng Pu, Taishi Ci, I will present the petition to our lord tomorrow; prepare your forces accordingly.
Please tell me whether you insist I present you first to receive formal commission, or whether I should submit the petition and issue travel papers so you can depart promptly.
Confirm your final accompanying numbers and the names for personal guards and subordinate posts; if there are no changes, reply 'no change.'
Upon receiving your replies I will submit the petition and prepare the travel pass and departure date so orders may be issued without delay.
程普:

张昭:
(inner monologue: （内心独白）：敬啓孫都尉孫策大人：伏惟時局未安，邊務亟需措置，臣敢以微謀具陳請命。 张昭（内心独白）：擬薦太史慈為督軍，署神亭嶺以扼沿海要衝，初駐精銳五百人。 张昭（内心独白）：若朝廷兵力允可，乞准於神亭嶺再增二百為後援；會稽預置精銳二百以資互援。 张昭（内心独白）：且令太史慈留親衛五十常侍幼主，以固內外之備。 张昭（内心独白）：又擬薦程普率水軍隨行五百人，得擴充至一千人者可循例辦理。 张昭（內心独白）：若擴編，約需五日至七日方可整備具足。 张昭（內心独白）：在其部中，擬列韓當為督率水軍之副將，專督操練巡航與臨戰指揮。 张昭（內心独白）：列黃蓋為督造及火攻、護運之將，專掌軍器戰艦與護運火攻之務。 张昭（内心独白）：伏乞主公允准，並頒行路引與出發期，以便各處遵命整饬。 张昭（内心独白）：凡以五百人為準，三日可集結；若增至七百或一千人，則需五至七日備具。 张昭（内心独白）：關於親衛與會稽等佐將之具體人選，臣願代為薦介數員，亦聽主公親定。 张昭（内心独白）：臣以邊備未固，宜速决；若蒙允者，乞即頒行路引、示出發日，臣等即率所屬整軍待發。 张昭（内心独白）：行路引要點：各部於本府受命之營屯集合，行前三日入報實數備查。 张昭（内心独白）：隨行兵額與時間：以五百為準三日內集結，若擴編七百或一千另計需五至七日。 张昭（内心独白）：船舶器械：程普所部主力戰舟隨行，黃蓋督造整治戰艦並備火器。 张昭（内心独白）：物資糧餉先行簽發三日行軍糧，沿途補給點與護運路線會稽預置二百協助。 张昭（内心独白）：軍令通信設烽警哨所與聯絡儀式，行路中軍令自督軍主將發出，副將遵令執行。 张昭（内心独白）：護送與內衛太史慈親衛五十常侍幼主，沿途預置小股護衛以防內怠。 张昭（内心独白）：緊急應變若遇敵變或交通阻滯，督軍得即行調度會稽預置之二百互援，重大變故呈報主公。 张昭（內心独白）：行路安全嚴控哨夜，船隊按隊形行進並設護運分隊，避險要道夜行節制。 张昭（内心独白）：建議出發時限：以五百人為準，自命令下達之日起三日內可行。 张昭（内心独白）：若擴編至七百或一千人，需五至七日整備期方可發運。 张昭（内心独白）：擬呈之薦介人選說明：督軍署神亭嶺為太史慈。 张昭（内心独白）：督率水軍為程普，副將為韓當；督造與火攻護運為黃蓋。 张昭（内心独白）：會稽預置兵二百之佐將預留二至三員，擬由張臣等先薦或由主公親定。 张昭（内心独白）：親衛五十名額預留，擬由張臣會同太史慈程普薦介；若主公欲親定，俟命。 张昭（内心独白）：其他需署之副將守備預留若干席位，待主公裁決或令臣等薦介。 张昭（内心独白）：若主公許可，臣可即行擬就詳列薦介名單與行路引正文，俟示下即呈。)

并确认是否同意在我方、赵云与许褚三方确认到位并由许褚核实情报后即刻发起，约十五分钟为可行时点。
赵云，请回报可从三十一人中抽出多少人执行截断与掩护，建议不逾十五人。
并请指明何时能入城并私呈情报给许褚或掩护首领张勇。
许褚，请确认你所言之十名精兵能否在约一刻钟内到位并回报到场时间。
三方速回，则按此时刻整编出发；有异议速言。

张飞:
许褚、赵云、诸葛亮，吾可率三百精锐夜袭，分两路突击，以速取先锋为要，绝不缠斗。
依许褚所言，待赵云主力入内并十名掩护到位后即发，按当前估计约十五分钟到位。
吾建议出发时间定为约十五分钟后，夜袭全程不逾三十分钟，遇阻立即撤回。
撤退集合地为南河桥，出发信号与撤退信号按既定办法执行（张勇低声清嗓三次为起，三短哨并口令“回”为撤）。
赵云请报能抽调执行截断与掩护之人数，许褚请确认十名掩护到位之确切时刻，吾此刻即行整编待命。

诸葛亮:
赵云，承你愿从。
城内后方收容与简易救治、城门把守由许褚负责；城内联络人定为许褚麾下掩护队长张勇。
入城暗号我方拍掌三次，情报私呈即认，请立报可抽调人数及入城时间与私呈方式。
许褚请确认十名精兵约一刻钟后能否到位并回报到场时间；张飞各自整编待命。
若三方确认到位，则按既定信号约十五分钟后即刻发动；未到位则暂缓。

赵云:
许将军，请示城内目前可动用守备兵力多少？
主力与次要哨位各驻何处？你以为城内防守最脆弱之处在哪里？有无可疑内应或需即刻加强的哨位？
并请评估张飞与诸葛亮之分工下，城中盟友之可靠性与我方截断任务的可行性有何补充建议。
若近来有敌情新动向或侦获之情报，也请一并回报。赵云恭候答复。

许褚:
赵将军，答复如下——
一、现有可动用兵力：城内防务由许褚与诸葛亮统筹，我掌管城门与城中主力，具体总数暂未详报。
张飞已回报可率三百精锐出击；你目前随行三十一人无伤。
我方已派十名精兵为引导与掩护，预计约一刻钟内到位；入内后我将布置两名向南河桥方向的隐蔽哨兵。
二、主力与次要哨位分布：南门及旧仓库與客栈一带为接应与暂驻区，十名掩护分为引导与掩护两队驻守南门东西巷口。
南河桥方向设外侧隐蔽哨位为撤退与观察点，其余城内巡逻由诸葛亮安排执行。
三、当前薄弱处与防范建议：南门与南侧河桥一带风险较高，入城务须压低声息并严守识别口令与白布臂章。
窄巷与屋后小道需加派暂时哨兵以防敌先遣渗入。暂未掌握确凿内应证据，但应立即强化门内哨位并复核识别。
四、对张飞/诸葛亮分工与截断任务评估：按既定分工可行，建议你从三十一人中抽调不超过十五人，若能抽调十人最稳妥。
该队应在你入城并私呈情报后尽速出发按既定路线截断敌粮道并在南河桥与主力会合。
张飞三百人足以主攻先锋，前提是你与许褚之掩护十人到位且各方信号确认。
五、敌情新动向：我方记有曹军主力南下之抵近威胁，夏侯惇率大军，但无更精确更新。
六、请求赵将军回报：能否从三十一人中抽调多少人（请报数，建议不超十五）？你预计何时能按暗号入城并私呈情报？
先遣五人已就位，十名掩护约一刻钟到位；见我拍掌三次并听到低声“白云”或见折布为入城信号。赵将军意下如何？

赵云:
许将军，报知——吾已即刻遣先遣五人张嵩、段威、韩广、李靖、周超，约五分钟后至南门外东巷隐蔽点待命。
今可从三十一人中抽调十二人执行截断与掩护，其余入城暂守待命。
烦请速复三点以便立即部署：一、十名精兵预计确切到位的整点分钟是几分？
二、掩护首领张勇到位后将与我方先遣联络的具体躲藏点或方位为何？例如东巷第几处屋檐或矮墙旁？
到位确认仍以低声“白云”＋折布低举为二次确认吗？
三、入城后我方应将侦得情报私呈张勇或仍先呈许将军？私呈地点是否仍定南门东侧旧仓库？
若以上无异议，我方抽调十二人并即刻按既定分批部署准备，恭候回报。

许褚:
赵将军，回报如下——
一、十名精兵到位时间约十五分钟后，自今刻起约十五分钟内到场并占位就绪。
二、先遣联络点与到位确认：先遣五人请隐藏于南门外东巷向东数第三处矮墙／屋檐旁并隐蔽等候。
掩护首领到位之二次确认仍以低声“白云”作口头确认并以折布低举于腰侧作视觉确认。
掩护首领到位后会再以低声三次清嗓或短促手势与先遣完成内部确认。
見我拍掌三次且掩護首領“白云”或折布任一確認到位時，即為進城信號。
三、情报私呈与地点：入城后请先将情报私呈掩护队长张勇；若我近旁亦可同时示我。
私呈地点以南门东侧旧仓库内后廊或客栈后院小间为准，切勿在门外或露天处示情报。
四、关于你拟抽调的十二人：同意抽调十二人，建议编组为一队十人截断粮道，二人作联络与撤退引导。
截断出发仅在掩护到位并经我或张勇以低声三次发出起点信号后进行；撤退集合点为南河桥，撤退信号为三短哨并口令“回”。
五、请回报先遣五人是否已按预期到位（如已到请回“已到”），十二人是否已整编完毕并可在接到信号后即刻出发。
许褚此处就绪，十名掩护约一刻钟到位；见我拍掌三次并听到低声“白云”或见折布任一确认时为进城时刻。赵将军意下如何？

赵云:
许将军，回报——先遣五人张嵩、段威、韩广、李靖、周超已按令到位，隐蔽于南门外东巷向东数第三处矮墙旁，已到。
我方已整编十二人执行外侧截断与掩护，余十九人在大槐树下按次序待命。
见你拍掌三次即分批入城隐蔽。十二人只在掩护十人确到并由你或张勇低声三次确认或折布示意后出发。
撤退集合地为南河桥，撤退信号为三短哨并口令“回”。入城后侦得情报我方先私呈张勇或许将军，地点为南门东侧旧仓库后廊。
烦请回报十名精兵到位的确切整点分钟，以便同步出发。赵云恭候。

赵云:
张将军、许将军、孔明先生，回报我方态势——先遣五人已就位于东巷第三区矮墙隐蔽点。
十二名截断与掩护精兵已整编完毕，主力十九人按大槐树下待命。
许将军回报十名精兵约十五分钟后到位，入城进退信号按既定：许将军拍掌三次為主暗號。
掩護首領張勇以低聲“白云”或折布低舉作二次確認，撤退信號為三短哨並口令“回”。
現請三方最終確認：是否按約在約十五分鐘後（自今刻起約15分鐘）发动夜袭？若同意，請明示整點分鐘或回“同意”。
赵云恭候回報。

许褚:
诸位请速确认现状回报——赵云先遣五人已就位，十二人截断已整编，主力十九人待命于大槐树下。
我方十名掩护预计约十五分钟后到位。基于此我方同意按既定预案发动夜袭，前提为掩护十人确到且三方确认到位后始发。
起点信号为我或掩护首领张勇低声清嗓三次；截断队在掩护到位并经我或张勇低声三次确认后由先遣引导出发。
撤退集合南河桥，撤退信号为同时吹三短哨并口令“回”。
现请求三方最终回报：张飞可否按此前整编三百分两路在约十五分钟后待命且不先发？
赵云可否确认十二人已整编并在掩护到位后按令出发？诸葛亮是否同意按此时机与信号发起？请回“同意”或速言异议。
Scene 35 · Xiangyang · rounds 47–51
Jia Xu:
They meet in Xiangyang.
Very well.
If scouts locate Zhang Xiu, confirm his identity in secret.
Verify with a token or a code phrase; do not expose yourselves.
If Zhang Xiu cannot come in person, first contact his aides or envoy.
Test their attitude and ensure their safety before any meeting.
Once a safe meeting place is confirmed, report to me immediately.
I will travel light and bring a modest gift to show sincerity.

Cai Mao:
I will heed your instructions.
The token shall be a corner of folded white cloth.
The code phrase will be 'the modest gift is ready'.
If Zhang Xiu cannot come, meet his aides or envoy at a secluded guesthouse.
Scouts must only signal by token and code; do not reveal themselves.
Choose meeting sites with controllable access, like a guesthouse or the lone pavilion south of the city.
Beforehand, internal and external scouts will reconnoiter the terrain.
Set two withdrawal routes and place hidden guards against sudden threats.
Keep these preparations discreet and not publicized.
If safety is confirmed, scouts will use the agreed signal to report to you, Jia Xu.
We will await your arrival, then make the reception arrangements.
If anything seems abnormal or a trap, scouts must withdraw and signal back; do not advance.
The modest gift should be a small packet to show sincerity, not something valuable.
I will order the scouts to carry this out and report all findings to you promptly.
贾诩:
好。探子若寻得张绣所在，务必暗中以信物或暗语查明其人和意图。
切勿贸然现身；若张绣不便亲至，可先与其幕僚或代表接触试探，并确保其人安全。
一旦确认会面地点安全，速禀于我；我将轻装前往，携薄礼以示诚意。

蔡瑁:
贾公所言谨遵。
暗探接触时以信物与暗语验明身份；信物为折叠白布一角，暗语为薄礼已备。
若张绣不便亲来，先与其幕僚或代表在馆驿等偏僻处秘密接洽。
暗探仅以信物示意、以暗语试探，不可贸然露面。
会面地点择出入可控、周围便于暗中布防之处，例馆驿或城南孤亭。
会前由内外探子暗访地形，设两条撤退通道，并安插隐蔽护卫以防突发。
若确认安全，暗探即刻用约定信号向贾公禀报，俟公亲往再作迎接安排。
若有异常或疑为诱敌，暗探速撤并以信号回报，切勿冒进。
薄礼以小函为宜，以示诚意，不宜贵重。
依此我即令暗探实施，所获一切速禀于公。
Scene 36 · Weiyangdian · rounds 49–49
Ma Teng:
(moves; expected arrival turn 69.)
马腾:
(动身，预计回合 69 到位。)
Scene 37 · Xiaopei · rounds 49–49
Chen Deng:
(At Xiaopei, Chen Deng sends scouts to recon Cao Cao's camp. If you find Cao Cao, Zhang Liao, or their vanguard, deliver this letter stating I will act as an insider. Also request an immediate meeting. Report Xiapi and Xuzhou defenses, their sentries, and any insiders. Discuss the timing and the march route to seize Xiapi. Order the vanguard to promptly report receipt and the agreed time and place.)
陈登:
(小沛。陈登命数骑精兵直奔曹操军营周围侦察。 派几名骑兵侦查，遇见曹操、张辽或其先锋，就递交书札，说明我愿为内应，请速面见。 书札中要通报下邳与徐州的守备情况、哨卡与可用内应位置，并商议攻取下邳的时机与行军路线。 并嘱先锋务必速回报收悉，告知约见的时间与地点。)
Scene 38 · Xiangyang · rounds 59–78
Cai Mao:
(At Xiangyang, Cai Mao orders 500 ambushers to hide. They split into groups around the guesthouse and outer gate. He places hidden sentries and signalers and sets two retreat and block routes. He orders them to learn the terrain. Gatekeepers and outer scouts are to await the agreed code. On signal from Kuai Yue or Lady Cai they must act at once. They must shut the guesthouse and outer gates. They must cut off reinforcements and seize or kill Liu Bei. Actions must be swift, decisive, and discreet.)

Cai Mao:
Jia Xu, as you ordered.
Scouts are secretly probing Zhang Xiu's whereabouts.
They have identified several controlled meeting spots.
Five hundred ambushers are already in position.
Guesthouse gatekeepers and outer scouts await the code.
If we find him I will report at once.
If you go lightly to meet, I will arrange the reception and ensure security.
I await your instruction.

Jia Xu:
Good.
I will wait lightly and depart when scouts confirm with a folded white cloth corner and the code 'a small gift is ready'.
The meeting must be a secure reception, not an ambush.
The 500 ambushers are only for hidden escort and retreat cover; do not attack or set ambush at the meeting.
If scouts suspect deceit or danger, withdraw immediately and send the agreed signal to report.
Once informed I will go; before I arrive arrange reception and ensure security.

Cai Mao:
Understood.
Scouts have tested with a folded white cloth corner and the code 'a small gift is ready'.
Several controlled meeting spots have been probed.
Pre-meeting guards and retreat routes are arranged.
The 500 ambushers remain only for hidden escort and retreat cover.
They will not set ambushes at the meeting.
If scouts confirm the cloth and code I will report quickly.
Then you may travel lightly; I will set reception, open a safe passage, and guard the outer gate.
If scouts suspect deceit they will withdraw and signal, and I will tighten the guard and raise vigilance.
Tell me whether to wait on this plan or to depart immediately.

Jia Xu:
Good.
Wait until scouts confirm both the cloth corner and the code 'a small gift is ready' together.
Only then will we depart.
The 500 ambushers remain only for concealment and retreat cover.
If scouts suspect deceit or terrain risk, withdraw and send the agreed report.
Before the meeting secure the outer gate and open a hidden route for my light entry.
Also place one trusted officer outside the meeting site to wait in secret and escort or cover our representative's retreat.
Report when the signal comes; on receipt I will move.

Jia Xu:
Cai Mao, please list each controlled meeting place and report briefly.
Describe the terrain and exits for each.
Which is most secure and should be the first choice?
Are the cloth signal, the code, the 500 ambushers, and outer defenses all in place?
Where will the trusted officer wait?
Report quickly so I may travel light.

Cai Mao:
Jia Xu, I report the probed meeting sites and my recommendation.
The guesthouse is the primary choice; it has a front hall, main room, inner courtyard, and a back door.
Advantage: the courtyard offers protection and the meeting can be in an inner room or side hall.
This allows hidden guards and a concealed passage and makes it easy to guard the outer gate.
Drawback: travelers and servants may be present; they must be isolated and the gatekeepers bought off to prevent leaks.
Deployment: temporarily restrict the front door; use the back or side door as the hidden entry.
Place only a few hidden guards at the meeting spot and one clear retreat route.
The 500 ambushers stay outside the meeting site, deployed around the guesthouse perimeter and outer gate to guard and block reinforcements.
A trusted officer will wait outside the meeting site to escort or cover.
The southern lone pavilion, or Fengyi Pavilion, is remote with a single entrance.
Advantage: few passersby, easy to observe secretly and avoid others.
Drawback: exposed and lacking shelter; sudden events are hard to cover.
Use it for brief talks with staff, with guards outside and a prepared quick retreat; not ideal as the main venue.
The Han River ferry and Luochuan area lie by the water and suit secret evacuation by boat.
Advantage: small boats can serve as concealed routes for rapid withdrawal.
Drawback: river traffic is frequent and visible; it needs boatmen and favorable night conditions.
Use it as a concealed route and backup evacuation point, not as the primary indoor meeting place.
Recommendation: guesthouse as primary, Han River ferry as evacuation point, southern pavilion as backup.
All sites obey your order: the 500 ambushers are only for hidden escort and retreat cover and must not ambush at the meeting.
Scouts will use a folded white cloth corner and the code 'a small gift is ready' as confirmation.
If scouts suspect deceit they will withdraw and signal.
We will pre-visit, isolate unrelated people, close non-essential exits, open a hidden path, and place a trusted officer outside.
Once you pick a site I will arrange and verify the concealment and report when the signal arrives.
蔡瑁:
(命五百伏兵暗中就位，分作数股潜伏于館舍周围与外城门隐蔽要点。 安插隐蔽哨兵与联络兵，设定两条撤退与封锁通道并熟悉地形。 令館舍门吏与外城探子以约定暗号待命，接到蒯越或蔡夫人发出信号即刻出动。 出动后封闭館舍门与外城门，截断援军并擒杀刘备，行动须果断迅速且不可张扬。)

蔡瑁:
贾公，遵命。暗探正暗中查访张绣去向，已物色数处可控会面地点。
五百伏兵已暗中就位，館舍门吏与外城探子以暗号待命。
若得着落，必速禀报。若公拟轻装亲往觐见，微臣将按前约设接应并确保周全，请示意。

贾诩:
善。吾将轻装待命，俟暗探以折白布一角与暗语“薄礼已备”确报张绣着落即刻动身。
会面务必为安全接应，非诱敌之计；五百伏兵仅作隐蔽护卫与撤退掩护，切勿擅自发动或在会面处设伏。
若暗探疑有诈或情势异常，立即撤回并以约定信号回禀。
得报即行，微臣到达前请按约布置接应并确保周全。

蔡瑁:
贾公，讫。暗探已按约暗中试探，以折白布一角为信物，并以暗语“薄礼已备”试问张绣或其幕僚。
数处可控会面地点已暗访，会前护卫与撤退通道已布置完毕。
五百伏兵仅作隐蔽护卫与撤退掩护，绝不在会面处任意设伏或诱敌。
若暗探确报折白布与暗语到位，吾即速禀报，届时公可轻装动身；微臣将按约设接应、打开安全通道并守固外城门。
若暗探疑有诈，暗探速撤并以约定信号回禀，微臣亦将即刻收缩护卫并加严戒备。
望示是否照此待命，或即刻启程？

贾诩:
善。依汝所言，静待暗探确报折白布一角与暗语“薄礼已备”同时到位，我方方启程。
五百伏兵仅作隐蔽护卫与撤退掩护，切勿在会面处设伏或主动发动。
若暗探疑有诈或地形异常，速撤并以约定信号回禀。
会面前务必守固外城门并开一条隐蔽通道，以便我轻装入内。
另令一名可信部将在会面地外暗中待命，随时护送或掩护代表撤退。
得信号即速禀告，信到我即动身。

贾诩:
蔡将，请将已物色之数处可控会面地点逐一简明回报。各处地形与出入口如何？哪处最稳妥可作首选？
折白布与暗语、五百伏兵与外城守备是否皆已就位？可信部将在何处暗候？
得报我即轻装动身，请速回。

蔡瑁:
贾公，谨将已物色之数处可控会面地点逐项回报，并荐首选如下。
館驿（首选）：格局为前厅正房、内院与后门，出入口可短时封闭并由门吏控制。
利：院落有围护，便于将会置于内房或偏厅，利于安置隐蔽护卫与开隐蔽通道。
便于我方就近守固外城门以控制进出。弊：館内或有旅客与仆役，须事前隔离并收买门吏以防走漏风声。
隐蔽程度：高（经事前处置）。部署建议：会前将前门暂时限制出入，后门或侧门作隐蔽进出通道。
会面处仅放少量隐蔽护卫并预设一条撤退通道；五百伏兵不入会面场所，布于館驿外围与外城门处作隐蔽护卫与截援。
派一可信部将在会面地外待命并护送或掩护。
城南孤亭（或凤仪亭）：位置偏僻、通行少，出入口单一。
利：人烟稀少，易于暗中侦察与避开旁人。弊：无遮蔽与内屋，突发情形难以掩护与隔离，会面者曝光风险高。
隐蔽程度：中（需夜色或天气掩护）。部署建议：可作与幕僚或代表的短促密谈处，若作会面须在亭外布置护卫并准备快速撤离路线，不宜作为正会场。
汉江渡口／罗川口一带：靠水利于秘密撤离与舟上接应。
利：可利用小舟做隐蔽通道与迅速抽离；对方若需倚水撤退亦便。弊：河面通行多、易被目击，需水手与舟伶配合且视夜色而定。
隐蔽程度：中偏高（夜间较佳）。部署建议：作为隐蔽通道与备用撤离点，不作为首选会面室内点；会前需派人夜访并与舟人定好暗号与上舟位置。
推荐与总则：首选館驿，因可控性最高、最易按公所令开隐蔽通道并守固外城门。
汉江渡口为首选撤离接应点；城南孤亭可做幕僚短会或备选。
所有地点一律遵守贾公令：五百伏兵仅作隐蔽护卫与撤退掩护，不在会面处设伏或诱敌。
暗探以折白布一角与暗语“薄礼已备”为确报信号；暗探若疑有诈速撤并回禀。
吾方将按所选地点事先暗访、隔离无关人员、封锁非须出入口、开隐蔽通道并安排一名可信部将在外待命。
若公定某处，微臣即刻按此布置并复核隐蔽性，得信到即来禀报。
Scene 39 · Xiaopei · rounds 61–61
Chen Deng:
(The scene is at Xiaopei. Order insiders in Xiapi and Xuzhou to stand ready tonight. Have them record defense points and sentry posts. Also note gates that can open and hidden troop spots. Put those details into secret notes. Tie each note to an arrow and shoot it into the city. Set a night signal, such as three simultaneous fires outside. On that signal, immediately open the back gate. Break into the city and engage the enemy to lure Cao's troops inside. Coordinate the assault with the insiders to storm the city. Send elite scouts to watch Cao's army and its vanguard day and night. Report any unusual movement within 24 hours. Have them report receipt of this to Cao Cao and his vanguard. Tell Cao Cao I am the insider, ready to cooperate to take Xiapi. Once Cao's attack time and route are fixed, execute at once.)
陈登:
(下邳与徐州守备内应听着，立刻就位待命。 连夜把守备要点、哨卡位置、可开的门与潜伏兵力，写成密札，拴在箭上射入城中以作联络备用。 夜间信号定为关外三处同时放火为号，一旦接获曹军逼近信号，立即开后门破城引曹军入内协同突入。 派精斥候昼夜监视曹军与先锋动向，凡有异动二十四小时内速报。 并请将此收悉回报给曹操与其先锋，告知我已为内应，随时准备按约配合攻取下邳。 待曹军确定进攻时间与行军路线后即刻执行。)
Scene 40 · Jiangxia · rounds 62–62
Zhou Yu:
(studies the day's repair and training report. He then issues orders. Prioritize repair of ships ready for immediate deployment. Finish eighty small skiffs and ten main warships first. Mark ships unfit for immediate battle as awaiting repair. Gather repair materials for them in one place. Send two teams of artisans to work night shifts. Ensure their rations and tools are supplied. Centralize storage of oils and combustible materials. Assign two camps to guard them on a rotating watch. Submit today's repair and drills summary to me before dusk. Also deliver tomorrow's repair plan to me before dusk. Order the two scouts to recon Jianye's official ships tonight. Have them learn the expected arrival time for the supplies. Report that arrival estimate to me at once. Adjust repair priorities according to their report immediately.)
周瑜:
(江夏。周瑜审阅今日修复与操练详报后下令。 优先修复立即可上阵的战船，先完工80艘小舢板与10艘主战船。 对损至不能即刻出战者列为待修，集中材料修复。 增派两组匠人夜间加班，务必保障其粮饷与工具。 集中保管油脂与燃器材，指派两营轮值看守。 今日修复与操练汇总与明日修复计划，须于每黄昏前呈报我。 督促此前两名探报信使连夜打探建业官船与物资调发预计到达时间。 收到回报即刻传我，并按回报调整修复优先级。)
Scene 41 · Boling Ferry · rounds 62–65
Cao Ren:
(At Boling Ferry, Cao Ren issues orders. Three scouting parties, speed up your reports now. If you sight Zhang Fei's banners, signal immediately. Also report his troop size and marching direction. If small enemy groups land, send the same signal. Dispatch light interception squads to the upper reach. And to the middle and lower reaches as well. When intercepting, avoid frontal contact; delay and hold. Report casualties and enemy positions at once. Crossbowmen at each post, take station and prepare. On signal, blow the horn and fire a covering volley. Protect moored ships and our withdrawal routes first. Send fast riders to Xiaopei, Xiapi, and Xuzhou for aid. Ask them to restrain or intercept enemy nearby. Inform them of our alert status. Give the locations of our withdrawal routes. Ensure rear support and retreat lines stay open.)

Cao Ren:
(At Boling Ferry, Cao Ren reiterates crossbow orders. Crossbowmen, take your positions without delay. Captains, be ready to sound the horn on signal. Then fire a coordinated volley to cover our troops. Inspect every ballista; confirm each machine is sound. Make sure bolts are ample and spare ammo is close. Set up protective positions and clear firing sectors. Do not allow crossbowmen to engage in close combat. Sentries on upper, middle, lower—raise your watch. Keep signal links ready to send reports at once. On any landing or banner, send the prearranged signal. And report the enemy's location and their numbers. Crossbowmen stand guard day and night; rotate by shifts. Rear supply remains ready to resupply at any time. Guard the moored ships and withdrawal routes first. Report any abnormality to command immediately. Then begin interception and coordinated volleys.)
曹仁:
(立即催促三路斥候加快回报。 侦得张飞旗号、兵力规模、行进方向或小股靠岸，须立即发回预定信号。 命轻装拦截小队按上游、中段、下游分段就近出动。 拦截时禁止与敌正面接触，以牵制拖延为要并回报伤亡与方位。 令弩手各阵位立即就位。 收到预定信号即鸣号示警并同步齐射掩护。 重点保护系缆船只与撤退通道。 派快马向小沛、下邳、徐州方向传话，请求就近部队牵制或阻截。 并通报当前戒备情况与撤退通道位置，确保后援与撤退联络畅通。)

曹仁:
(弩手各阵位立即就位，弩长接令准备鸣号齐射。 一旦收到预定信号，立即鸣号示警并同步齐射掩护。 命弩手逐机检点，确认弩机完好、箭矢充足，备用弹药就近待命。 配置掩护与射界，严禁与敌近身格斗。 命三路哨兵（上游/中段/下游）加强观测与信号联络。 侦得敌军靠岸、集结、旗号或行进方向即刻发回预定信号，并标明方位与规模。 弩手昼夜戒备，按班次轮换休整，后方补给随时待命。 重点防护系缆船只与撤退通道，任何异常即刻回报指挥部并启动拦截与齐射程序。)

外运与护送：首批自仓甲外运300石，押运按100人为一队，关羽拟统领并派20骑前探；若陛下许可即刻发车。
若盘点原件当面到手，臣将当面报装载明细與确时后由关羽押运。
外交建议：对孙权采取条件性协作，首求粮饷4000石及至少一月兵饷；若能获牵制或水师配合更佳。
臣拟按陛下底线交换互惠条款试探其态度，恳请陛下示下最终底线，臣即奉行。
盘点单仍在路上，若到手臣将于十五分钟内呈交逐项精确表。
恭候陛下裁示：准臣即刻出使否？准先拨并发运首批300石否？如有对孙权之最低条件，请示下，臣即携诏书启程并速回。

关羽:
糜竺、孙乾、陛下：请当面递交逐仓签字原件、逐仓护库人员名单与府主簿姓名及首批拟拨款明细。
孙乾请报盘点单到达确时，并即时报首批外运拟行路线、300石装载明细与所需护送兵力。
首批押运（100名护卫、20骑前探）已就绪，拟按既定确时出发；若需改定出发确时或补足单证，请立即回报。

糜竺:
孙乾，盘点单到手否？
若已到，请当面将盘点原件呈于我或指示我去取，我将在十五分钟内整理逐项精确数值并上呈陛下。
若尚在路上，请报预计到达确时并说明是否需护送。

刘备:
已悉你所呈之逐仓初报，今令如下——
准许你按此前奏议先行拨付首拨款项，用于自仓甲外运之300石之运费與兵饷。
请当面报出府主簿姓名与首拨明细（金额、用途、各仓支出項），并即刻落实拨付与留账，主簿须在场并签字备查。
请当面向朕与孙乾呈交逐仓签字原件與逐仓护库人员名单（含仓号、人员、职务、签名），以便核对并入账。
外运与护送按既定顺序与编制执行：首批自仓甲300石已核准外运，护送按关羽所率之编制进行。
时限：请在十分钟内报回府主簿姓名與首拨明细；逐仓签字原件已呈或精盘预计到达确时；如需额外拨款或增派护送兵力之具体数目与理由。
精盘到手后十五分钟内将逐项精确数值呈朕。
速行，朕候旨。
Scene 43 · Xuchang · rounds 62–79
Yu Jin:
Your Majesty, Governor Zhang, generals, act on the prior plan at once.
Gates—South, North, East, West—about 160 men each.
Battlement crossbowmen forty per battlement, rotate day and night.
Xiahou Yuan, Yue Jin, and Yu Jin keep three scout routes nearby and concealed.
Do not pursue the enemy main force; if met by heavy troops, withdraw to strong ground and notify the commander and the Emperor first.
Yue Jin will present warehouse and unit-by-unit grain and weapons inventories, list shortages and estimated arrival times.
Xiahou Dun will oversee city defense, manage the elite reserve, and enforce guards on key approaches.
Any suspected insiders are to be detained, interrogated, and the names reported to the commander.
Governor Zhang will coordinate overall; within one hour present troop counts, patrol and scout numbers, coordinates and liaison names, and supply shortfalls to the commander, the Emperor, Xun Yu, and Cheng Yu.

Zhang Liao:
Gentlemen, initial reports received in full.
To help Xun Yu and Cheng Yu draft Xuchang's defense, order Xiahou Dun, Xiahou Yuan, Yu Jin, Yue Jin, and Xu Shu to submit itemized details to the commander.
Provide: actual deployable foot soldiers for South/North/East/West gates, rotation shifts and exact posts.
Also submit each unit's grain and weapon stocks, shortages, and expected resupply times.
Give liaison names and current coordinates for each patrol and scout unit.
State the city elite reserve headcount, standby location, and rapid-deployment route.
List names and coordinates of any captured or suspected insiders and proposed initial handling.
Return these details within one hour so Xun Yu and Cheng Yu can compile the draft.

Xiahou Dun:
Yue Jin, I have your report and the three-route sortie news.
First, deliver seized supplies to the commander’s designated warehouse; you will inventory and record receipt.
Second, provide in writing the exact numbers of foot soldiers at each gate, battlement crossbowmen and rotation shifts, and patrol and scout troop counts with coordinates and routes.
Third, list by warehouse and unit grain and weapon stocks and shortages; mark escort teams, escort strength, routes and expected arrival times.
Fourth, specify the number of missing heavy crossbows and pack horses and propose priority sources and ETA.
Fifth, maintain scout report cadence: sunrise and sunset reports, immediate night reports on supply signs or enemy contact.
Sixth, detain any suspected insiders and bring them to the commander for interrogation.
Be fast, accurate, and thorough; deliver the written preliminary report within one hour and copy to me, Xun Yu, and Cheng Yu.

Cheng Yu:
Yue Jin, one more question about Xu's mother's letter—will you retrieve it at midnight as planned?
If you still go at midnight, be punctual, fetch it, and report immediately; keep silent on the road.
If changed to tomorrow at the third quarter past noon at the guesthouse, follow Xu's instructions then and report first.

Cheng Yu:
Yue Jin, will you still go at midnight to take Xu's mother's letter at Xuchang's east?
If you will, fetch it on time and report swiftly, and keep silent on the road.
If the meeting has been rescheduled, report at once to me and Lord Cheng.

Yue Jin:
Lord Cheng, understood.
I will go at midnight to the east of Xuchang as arranged.
I will be silent on the road and will report immediately if blocked or delayed.
I will return straightaway to report after retrieval.

Xu Shu:
Lord Cheng, Governor Zhang, I have organized Le Jin and Xiahou Yuan's initial returns into Xuchang's defense draft; please review.
Key points—Gates: South/North/East/West about 160 men each, battlement crossbowmen forty each, with day–night rotation.
City elite reserve roughly forty men, near the commander’s office under Xiahou Dun with a rapid-deploy route.
Three scout routes: Route One to Chenliu—Xiahou Yuan 100 cavalry in concealed high ground; Route Two to Puyang—Yue Jin 100 cavalry in southern sheltering woods; Route Three along the Yellow River to Boling—Yu Jin 100 cavalry at the crossing northwest.
Each route has a liaison to the commander, reports at sunrise and sunset, and immediate reporting on enemy contact.
Water hazards and river crossings—naval and light-cavalry guards 30–50 men each with covert sentries.
Outer moat sentries three posts per li, fifty men per post, nightly patrols and traps.
Seized supplies to be escorted to the commander’s warehouse and recorded by Yue Jin; Yue Jin summarizes shortages of heavy crossbows and pack horses.
Trigger conditions and priorities for relief are listed; if approved I will convert this draft into location-by-location tables for signature and dispatch.

Xiahou Dun:
Yu Jin, I acknowledge your return.
First, within half an hour submit in writing the North Gate current garrison and deployable soldiers, battlement crossbowmen numbers and rotation shifts, and copy me.
Second, report patrol and scout troop counts, current coordinates, and proposed routes.
Third, list grain and weapon stocks warehouse by warehouse and by unit, shortages, escort teams, escort numbers, routes and ETA (Yue Jin to record receipts).
Fourth, if captured supplies or suspicious insiders are found, detain and send them to the commander; evidence to be escorted by the liaison and preserved.
Maintain reporting cadence; immediate night reports on enemy or supply signs, and keep intelligence linked with Xiahou Yuan, Yue Jin, and Xiahou Dun.

Xun Yu:
Governor Zhang, generals, I have compiled the returns and present Xuchang's initial defense proposal.
Gate deployments—South/North/East/West about 160 men each, battlement crossbowmen about 40 each, day–night rotation.
Elite reserves roughly 40 men sited on key routes for rapid deployment under Xiahou Dun.
Scouts—three light-cavalry routes of about 100 each: Xiahou Yuan toward Chenliu, Yue Jin toward Puyang, Yu Jin along the Yellow River to Boling crossing.
Scouts to hold concealed positions, liaise day and night with the commander; reports at sunrise and sunset and immediate reports on enemy contact.
Supplies—Yue Jin to receipt seized supplies and keep accounting; escorts bring goods to the commander’s designated warehouse.
Combat principle—seize and escort enemy supplies but do not pursue main force; withdraw to strong ground and report immediately if met by heavy troops.
Each general must, within half an hour, submit counts for gates, battlement crossbowmen, scout numbers and coordinates, warehouse and weapon shortfalls, and names of suspected insiders.
I and Cheng Yu will convert this into Xuchang's draft for the commander and the Emperor; act fast and report immediately.

Xiahou Yuan:
(Stage: Xiahou Yuan orders twenty riders to escort the seized supplies to the commander’s warehouse. Stage: The escort is led by Zhao Guang, Route One liaison; composition: fifteen from Route One, five drawn from the city garrison. Stage: They depart immediately from Chenliu's concealed high ground, taking small paths to avoid the main road. Stage: The escort will be ready and concealed nearby; remaining units remain on watch and reconnaissance. Stage: If met by unfavorable enemy forces they are to retreat to strong ground and urgently notify the commander; the liaison keeps day–night contact. Stage: Estimated round 2 arrival.)

Emperor Xian of Han:
Xun Yu, Governor Zhang, Yue Jin, Xiahou Dun, Xiahou Yuan, Yu Jin: I have read Xun Yu's summary.
Xun Yu must include gate details, battlement crossbowmen counts and rotations, and three-route patrol strengths and coordinates in the draft.
List each granary and reserve grain bags, current weapons and shortages, liaison names and how to contact them, and suspected insiders with handling suggestions.
Xun Yu must propose priority supplies and allocation order; submit within one hour to me, Governor Zhang, and Cheng Yu.
Yue Jin must immediately complete the warehouse-by-warehouse weapon and grain inventory, receipt seized supplies and preserve evidence.
Governor Zhang must ensure the four gates hold to reported numbers; report shortages with requested reinforcements and ETAs.
Xiahou Yuan, Yue Jin, and Yu Jin continue nearby reconnaissance and escort seized supplies to the commander’s warehouse; do not chase the enemy main force.
If met by heavy enemy, withdraw to secure terrain and report immediately to the commander and to me.
Xiahou Dun shall supervise city elite and night patrols, guard against insiders, detain suspects and report names.

Zhang Liao:
Your Majesty, I accept the imperial orders.
I have instructed Xun Yu and Cheng Yu to compile the Xuchang defense draft from the initial reports.
Xiahou Dun, Xiahou Yuan, Yu Jin, Yue Jin, and Xu Shu must submit itemized details and liaison names within one hour.
Yue Jin is auditing and receipting the weapons and grain; Xiahou Yuan’s scouts remain concealed and ready to report.
Regarding Xu Shu and his mother, I have asked Cheng Yu to verify secretly; if recall is advisable I will comply.

Cheng Yu:
(inner monologue: (thought): I will frame a recall for Xu Shu using Xu's mother's letter in three parts: wording, verification, and reception. Cheng Yu (thought): First, wording—sincere, filial, low for household distress; use phrases like 'old mother grows weak' and 'only a son can save us.' Cheng Yu (thought): Include private verification points: a small family seal impression, the household folding habit, a family pet name or childhood nickname, and two characteristic handwriting marks. Cheng Yu (thought): Second, delivery and verification chain—Le Jin retrieves, does a quick on‑site check of up to three verification points, seals the letter, and rushes it to Cheng Yu for final review. Cheng Yu (thought): Sample report on departure: 'Yue Jin has the sealed pouch; leaving now.' Cheng Yu (thought): On initial check report: 'Initial check: seal and fold match; sealing now and returning.' Cheng Yu (thought): If initial check doubtful: 'Initial check doubtful; sealed and halted; await Cheng Yu's review.' Cheng Yu (thought): Third, post-verification actions—three outcomes: authenticated, suspected, or forged, each with set handlers and limited disclosure. Cheng Yu (thought): If authenticated, Cheng Yu stores the original in the secret archive, notifies Zhang Liao and Xun Yu, and prepares a low-key recall. Cheng Yu (thought): If suspected, seal and summon Xun Yu for a second verification and quietly seek one private confirmation from Xu Shu by a private message. Cheng Yu (thought): If forged, seal the document, keep it among three chiefs only, and open a secret inquiry into the source. Cheng Yu (thought): Fourth, reception and shelter—invite Xu Shu to a discreet interior room or a private guest chamber; Yue Jin escorts quietly and Cheng Yu assigns a hidden safe room under Xiahou Dun's protection. Cheng Yu (thought): Limit visitors to Cheng Yu, Xun Yu, and Zhang Liao; provide respectful hospitality, a minor gift, and controlled movement under the pretext of ensuring his mother's safety. Cheng Yu (thought): Fifth, contingency—if the letter is a trap, seal it and suspend recall; if Yue Jin is stopped or killed, close the plan, replace the courier, and destroy loose records. Cheng Yu (thought): Sixth, timeline and duties—T‑2 prepare wording and verification list, T‑1 Yue Jin departs with seal and list, T at midnight retrieve and quick‑check, T+1 Cheng Yu finalizes, T+2–T+6 arrange meeting or concealment. Cheng Yu (thought): Orders to give directly—To Yue Jin: 'At midnight, retrieve the letter with the seal and verification list; if two checks match, seal as No.1 and return to Cheng Yu immediately.' Cheng Yu (thought): To Cheng Yu himself: 'On receipt, verify all points; if authenticated, notify Zhang Liao and Xun Yu and prepare discreet reception; if doubtful, keep sealed and call for private review.' Cheng Yu (thought): Keep knowledge minimal, seal everything, and do not publicize until Xu Shu is safely in controlled custody or refuses.)

Xun Yu:
Your Majesty, obediently received.
I have incorporated the Emperor's items into Xuchang's defense draft.
Brief report—four gates about 160 each, battlement crossbowmen 40 each, day–night rotation; elite reserve about 40 men.
Scouts three routes about 100 each, liaison direct to the commander, sunrise and sunset reports and immediate reports on enemy contact.
Yue Jin to prioritize warehouse and unit inventories, receipt seized supplies and preserve evidence.
Xiahou Yuan, Yue Jin, Yu Jin must submit detailed per‑gate and per‑unit data within one hour; Cheng Yu and I will compile and present to the Emperor and Governor Zhang.

Yu Jin:
Your Majesty, Governor Zhang, Cheng Yu, Xun Yu, generals, I have read Xun Yu's draft.
Xun Yu and Cheng Yu must finalize the draft, mark priority supplies and allocation order, and submit in half an hour.
Yue Jin, immediately inventory seized supplies, make receipts, and report heavy crossbows and pack horse shortfalls by warehouse.
Governor Zhang, ensure the four gates hold; if short, reassign from nearby camps and report exact numbers.
Xiahou Yuan, Yue Jin, and Yu Jin maintain concealed observation; do not pursue the enemy main force and report at once on heavy contact.
Xiahou Dun, tighten city elite and night patrols; detain suspects and submit names to the commander.
Cheng Yu, verify suspected insider lines with Xun Yu and report findings; command post to compile all details within one hour.

Cheng Yu:
Yue Jin—at midnight go as agreed to the east of Xuchang to take Xu's mother's letter.
Carry a sealed pouch and the verification checklist; bring only one escort.
On receipt, check three items: family seal, fold and two private names or handwriting marks.
If two or more checks match, apply Seal No.1 and return immediately to Cheng Yu for final review.
If doubtful or not matching, seal and report without delay; keep silent on the road.

Xu Shu:
Lord Cheng, Governor Zhang, I have revised and finalized Xuchang's defense tables and material shortfalls.
Summary—gates 160 each, battlement five crossbowmen per slot; elite reserve about 40 under Xiahou Dun.
Outer moat posts three per li, fifty men each; scouts three routes 100 each; river crossings 30–50 naval or light cavalry per point.
Priority shortages: about thirty heavy crossbows, forty pack horses, some wagons and repair parts; Yue Jin responsible for receipt and allocation.
Please direct: shall I immediately allocate per this list and order Yue Jin to receipt?
Shall I confirm proposed sentry chiefs and crossbow overseers or await names?
May I convert this revised draft into location-by-location tables for signatures and issuance?

Emperor Xian of Han:
Yu Jin, I have read your prior returns.
Within one hour report these by item to the commander and copy to me: actual deployable troops at South/North/East/West gates and battlement crossbowmen numbers and rotations.
Also report patrol and scout troop counts, current coordinates and planned routes.
List each granary and reserve grain bags, current weapons and shortages and expected arrival times.
Give liaison names, contact methods and their coordinates.
If there are suspected insiders, list names and preliminary handling.
If outside aid or reinforcements are needed, provide required numbers, supplies, sources and estimated arrival times; report swiftly.

Xiahou Dun:
Yu Jin, I received your report.
Continue concealed reconnaissance; do not pursue the enemy main force.
If confronted by heavy enemy, withdraw to defensible ground and notify the commander and me immediately.
Within half an hour deliver a written initial report for the North Gate: current garrison, deployable soldiers, battlement crossbowmen counts and rotation shifts; copy me.
Also include patrol and scout troop counts, current coordinates and planned routes.
Inventory grain and weapons warehouse by warehouse and unit by unit, list shortages, mark escort teams and routes and expected arrival times (Yue Jin to record receipts).
Detain any captured supplies or suspected insiders and send them to the commander; preserve physical evidence via the liaison.
Maintain sunrise and sunset reports and immediate night warnings; coordinate intelligence with Xiahou Yuan, Yue Jin, and myself.
于禁:
启禀陛下、张都督、诸位将军，依此前议定，现下分令以便统筹执行。
四门守备按此前部署落实，南、北、东、西各约160人，垛口弩手各40人，垛口昼夜轮换到位。
夏侯渊、乐进、于禁三路侦骑继续就近隐蔽侦探，不得擅自深追敌主力。
遇敌重兵即退守坚固地形，并优先传讯都督部与陛下。
乐进即刻呈交逐仓逐队的粮饷与军器盘点表，列明短缺项与预计到援时点。
夏侯惇督守城内卫防，把管精锐预备队并督促要道把守。
凡遇可疑内应即行收押审问，并将名单上报都督部。
张都督统摄全局，一时辰内将各门可出动步卒、各队巡逻与侦骑人数、驻点坐标及联络官姓名与粮饷军器余缺逐项呈于都督部，并上陛下、荀彧、程昱。

张辽:
诸位，各路首报已悉。
为便荀彧、程昱汇总并拟定许昌防务初稿，令夏侯惇、夏侯渊、于禁、乐进、徐庶速呈逐项明细于都督部。
须呈南、北、东、西四门及各营可出动守城步卒实数，附昼夜轮换班次与每处驻守位置。
各队现有粮草与军器存量、短缺项及预计补给到援时点亦须逐项列明。
呈报各队联络官姓名与当前驻点坐标，城内精锐预备队人数、待命地点与快速出动路线。
并报已缴获或疑为内应之人名与坐标及初步处置建议。
限一时辰内回奏，荀彧、程昱即行汇总拟稿呈都督，所闻即奏。

夏侯惇:
乐进，承你禀。已悉三路出征与初报。
将所缴补给押运至都督部指定仓库，由你点收立账，保全证据并速上奏。
即刻详列并书面呈报各门与各营可出动守城步卒实数，含垛口弩手与轮换班次。
并报可用于巡逻与侦骑之兵数与驻点坐标，逐处粮饷与军器余量及短缺项，并标明护运队、护卫人数与路线与预计到援时点。
把短缺之重弩與辎重马匹数目列明并提出优先补给来源与预计到援时点。
侦骑回报频率照旧，日出日落例报，遇补给迹象或敌情即刻连夜速报。
凡遇可疑或疑为内应者先行收押带回都督部审问。务求速准详，一时辰内将书面初报呈都督部，并抄送吾与荀彧、程昱。

程昱:
乐进，在下再问，关于徐母家书之事，今夜子时取回仍为准否？
若仍按子时，务必按时取回并速来稟報，路上戒言。
若改为明日午后三刻于馆驿交接，届时按徐公旨行并先回稟。请即回禀。

程昱:
乐进，今夜子时于许昌城东取徐母家书之事，汝仍按子时赴否？
若仍赴，务必按时取回并速来稟報，路上戒言。
若已改期，请即回稟我与程公。

乐进:
程公，承知。今夜子时按原定前往许昌城东隐处取回徐母家书，路上戒言。
如遇阻滞或变更即刻回稟；取回后速来稟報。

徐庶:
程公、张都督，已据乐进回报与夏侯渊初报整理许昌防务初稿，请二位审阅并批示。
四门守备为南、北、东、西各约160人，垛口弩手各40人，垛口按垛配备并昼夜轮换。
城内精锐预备约40人，靠近都督部，夏侯惇督领并划定快速出动路线。
三路侦察：路一陈留方向夏侯渊100骑驻陈留郊外隐蔽高地；路二濮阳方向乐进100骑驻濮阳南侧掩蔽林；路三博陵/黄河于禁100骑驻博陵渡口西北。
每路配联络官直通都督部，回报日出日落，遇敌即刻速报。
水险与渡口汉水、黄河、博陵渡口置水师与轻骑哨队约30–50人/处并设暗哨盘查。
外壕每里三哨，每哨50人，夜间巡逻并设陷阱。
补给与缴获由联络官押运至都督部指定仓库，乐进点收立账并汇总短缺重弩與辎重马匹。
触发条件与优先救援顺序已列，若二位允可，微臣即将本稿整理为逐处表格以便逐项签批，并请批示是否即刻调拨缺口物资与确认为各哨长人选。

夏侯惇:
于禁，承你回报，今令如下。
即将北门现守与可调出守卒实际数、垛口弩手人数与昼夜轮换班次书面呈于都督部并抄送吾。
报明可用于巡逻與侦骑之兵数、各队当前驻点坐标與拟行路线。
逐仓逐队列明粮饷與军器余量及短缺項，标明护运队、护卫人数、路线與预计到援時点，乐进点收立账。
若有缴获补给或发现可疑内应，先行收押并押送都督部审问，物证由联络官押运并保全证据。
回报频率照旧，遇敌或见补给迹象即刻连夜速报。务求速准详，半刻内呈初报，并与夏侯渊、乐进保持情报通合。

荀彧:
张都督、诸位将军，吾已将诸路回报汇总，现先呈许昌防务首版部署建议，请诸位核阅并速补实数与缺项。
守城部署：四门各守卒约160人，垛口弩手各约40人，昼夜轮换；城内精锐预备约40人驻要道候命并预留快速出动路线。
侦骑部署：三路轻骑各约100人，路一夏侯渊向陈留、路二乐进向濮阳、路三于禁沿黄河北岸至博陵渡口，各队隐蔽驻点待机并昼夜直通都督部。
侦查回报日出日落例报，遇敌即刻速报。
粮饷军器：乐进点收所缴补给并立账保全，所缴补给由联络官押运至都督部指定仓库。
作战原则：可截断并押回敌补给但不得擅自深追敌主力，遇敌重兵优先退守坚固地形并即刻传讯。
请各将于半刻内逐项呈送明细，吾与程昱将据此拟成许昌防务初稿，呈都督与陛下裁示，速行，所闻即奏。

夏侯渊:
(命令抽二十骑押运所缴获补给回都督部，护运队由赵广领队，赵广为路一联络官。 护运队编制为路一出十五骑、城内抽五骑，立刻从陈留郊外隐蔽高地出发，沿小路避开主道押回许昌。 夏侯渊指示：预计行程约二时辰抵达，余队就近隐蔽待机继续戒备侦察。 夏侯渊指示：遇敌势不利即退守坚固地形并速传都督部，联络官昼夜直通都督部，押运途中若有变动即刻回报。)

汉献帝:
荀彧、张都督、乐进、夏侯惇、夏侯渊、于禁，朕已悉荀彧所呈汇总。
荀彧将各路回报汇总为许昌防务初稿，须含四门守备逐项、垛口弩手人数与昼夜轮换班次等细目。
须列三路巡逻與侦骑逐队可出动人数与驻点坐标，各粮仓與分储谷帛实存数与可用粮袋数及短缺项并标明预计到援時点。
须报现有军器数量与短缺，各队联络官姓名與联络方式、可疑内应名单與初步处置建议，并据此提出优先补给与调配次第建议。
限一时辰内呈朕与张都督、程昱。乐进即刻完成逐仓逐队的粮饷与军器盘点，点收所缴补给并保全证据立账。
张辽督促四门按初报人数严守，若有短缺速报并列明所需兵力軍器與预计到援時点。
夏侯渊、乐进、于禁继续就近侦探並押运缴获补给至都督部指定仓库，不得擅自深追敌主力。
夏侯惇督城内精锐与夜间巡逻，严防内应，凡可疑者即行收押并上报。所报即行，速呈。

张辽:
陛下，启禀，微臣谨承圣裁。
已令荀彧、程昱据各路首报汇总并拟许昌防务初稿，命夏侯惇、夏侯渊、于禁、乐进、徐庶一时辰内呈逐项明细并报驻点坐标与联络官姓名。
乐进正点收军器粮饷并立账，夏侯渊等三路侦骑隐蔽待机并速报。
关于徐庶与其母之事，臣已令程昱暗核，若可召回以增谋略，臣即从命办理。
若陛下欲发外援或增兵，请示所需兵数與预计到援時点，微臣随即统筹调拨，所闻即奏。

程昱:
(inner monologue: （内心独白）：拟定以徐母家书召回徐庶之计，分三部分给出可操作细则。 程昱（内心独白）：第一部分为家书措辞与必须包含的核验点，语气恳切虔孝，措辞避免官场用词，呈现家庭无以为继的柔弱口吻。 程昱（内心独白）：关键用词可选：“老身日短”“爹生前嘱托”“家中柴米难继”“汝若归，母即可安心”等。 程昱（内心独白）：诱心句示例可用：“若元直归来，老母愿穷尽力护汝；若不来，老身恐无立锥之地。” 程昱（内心独白）：必须包含且便于现场核认的核验点如家印私章印迹、纸张与折痕习惯、家中专属称谓、私密细节与笔迹特征。 程昱（内心独白）：家印示例：圆形红印右下角压印并有一处不规则纹。 程昱（内心独白）：纸张与折痕习惯示例：三折外翻或右上角向内折三角，边角常见污点位置可作核对。 程昱（内心独白）：私密称谓示例：家中对徐庶的童年小名或常用落款如“但愿此心可安——母亲××拜”。 程昱（内心独白）：私密细节示例：提及邻里某人名或家中旧物摆放位置等仅家中人知之事。 程昱（内心独白）：笔迹特征示例：某字最后一撇向上翘，另字中竖不收尾，选2–3字作现场比对。 程昱（内心独白）：第二部分为交付与验认操作步骤，遵最少知情原则：徐庶所委之人→乐进（初验）→现场封存→速送程昱终验。 程昱（内心独白）：取信前准备：乐进携密袋、封签蜡与核验清单赴约，仅带一名固定信使为护送。回报样板：“乐进已备密袋与核验清单，子时即发。” 程昱（内心独白）：现场接收：交付人先出示约定暗号与一件小物以验真，乐进录时间与交付代号。回报样板：“子时已取，交付代号合符，現在就地先驗。” 程昱（内心独白）：现场初验限三项核验点，若两项或以上符合则现场封存并以封签封条记录。回报样板：合格时“初驗：印、折、私詞兩項合符，已封存回運，擬即刻回稟。” 程昱（内心独白）：初驗疑似时回报：“初驗：一項不符，二項疑似。已封存，待程公復核。”初驗斷然不符时回报：“初驗：與家中核驗點不符，已封存，返報程公。” 程昱（内心独白）：封存與送達：原件當場封存，交接單只記時間與封簽號，僅報程昱，張、荀不在第一時間知情。回報樣板：“已封運，第X號封簽，預計二刻抵程公處。” 程昱（内心独白）：終驗由程昱親閱或指定唯一助手，核驗後寫入密件並復簽，並依結果決定下一步。 程昱（内心独白）：第三部分為驗認後稟奏與保密節點：分為認證實、疑似、斷然為偽三類處置。 程昱（内心独白）：認證實：程昱寫“已認證”，原件入密庫編號，簡報張遼與荀彧，除非徐庶到場不公開。發報樣板：“程昱稟：家書經三項終驗，可信。擬行召回，待張都督裁示。” 程昱（内心独白）：疑似：信件密封不公開，召荀彧復核，並以秘密渠道向徐庶再問一條私密問題以確認，暫不啟動召回。回報樣板：“疑函已封存，需復核。暫勿啟動召回。” 程昱（内心独白）：伪函：立即封存原件並限程昱、荀彧、張遼三人密議，禁止外泄，並建議閉口處理。回報樣板：“發現偽函，已封存，建議閉口處理，詳後密議。” 程昱（内心独白）：第四部分為徐庶見信來應的接應與安置方案，先以私名義邀約會面，地點選館驛偏室或內園私廳，路線避開要道哨口。 程昱（内心独白）：樂進負責沿路護送與隱秘引導，陪同一名面熟但不顯眼的侍從，並備一名可退回指揮部的護衛。 程昱（内心独白）：短期隱蔽住所以都督部下屬官房或館驛偏廂為首選，夏侯惇指派一處保密房間並安排兩名熟面孔護衛。 程昱（内心独白）：會面策略以恭敬為先，初會以“只為家恤”降低警戒，試探性詢問一兩項僅家中知曉之事觀察反應。 程昱（内心独白）：以禮遇與可即刻兌現的照料承諾穩其心，提出短期安置與出行報備制度以控制其行動。 程昱（内心独白）：第五部分為應急預案：若為敵方圈套或樂進路上遇阻遇害，要立即封存原件、撤回並封口，並由程昱主導秘密調查交付人背景。 程昱（内心独白）：若樂進受阻或遇害，夏侯惇立刻封鎖現場救護與收存證據，若樂進失聯則原件封存並啟替補人選。 程昱（内心独白）：第六部分為簡明時間表與分工：T-2程昱完成家書措辭與核驗清單，T-1樂進出發，T子時取信初驗封存，T+1程昱終驗決策。 程昱（内心独白）：分工：樂進取信初驗封存護送，程昱終驗與稟報，張遼與夏侯惇提供安置與護衛，荀彧提供情報支持。 程昱（内心独白）：可直接下達之命令樣本示例如下：給樂進：“今夜子時按約赴許昌城東隱處取徐母家書，攜密袋與核驗清單，僅隨一名護送。到手先驗三項，兩項合符即第X號封存速回程公處；疑或不符即刻回稟。路上戒言。” 程昱（内心独白）：給程昱終驗指令樣本：“收件後以核驗清單終驗，結果記為確實/疑似/伪，確實則密稟張都督與荀公備迎接方案；疑者閉口復核；伪者封存密議。” 程昱（内心独白）：給張遼/夏侯惇樣本指令：“程昱回稟家書可信，待命請備一處隐匿安置並候命，地點與人選暂不公开。” 程昱（内心独白）：凡注意事項：核驗點事先由程昱與徐庶秘密確認，記錄封簽號與交接單，流程避免公開，若有懷疑寧可暂停。 程昱（内心独白）：若需，程昱可把上述命令文本與核驗清單整理成執行單供樂進與程公使用。)

荀彧:
谨遵陛下。已将陛下最新所示诸项并入许昌防务初稿要点，请诸将遵行。
守城：四门逐项守备南北东西各约160名步卒，垛口弩手各约40人，昼夜轮换。
城内设精锐预备约40人驻要道候命并预留快速出动路线。
侦查：三路轻骑各约100人隐蔽驻点，联络官昼夜直通都督部，侦查回报日出日落例报，遇敌即刻速报。
粮饷军器：乐进优先逐仓逐队点收立账并保全证据，所缴补给由联络官押运至都督部指定仓库。
作战与押运原则：可截断并押回补给但不得擅自深追主力，遇敌重兵优先退守坚固地形并即刻传讯。
时限与分工：命夏侯渊、乐进、于禁于一时辰内将各门守备、巡逻与侦骑逐项明细呈都督部，乐进速呈盘点表并标明短缺与预计到援时点。
属下与程昱即刻统筹汇总，限一时辰内将许昌防务初稿整备呈陛下与张都督，速行，所闻即奏。

于禁:
启禀陛下、张都督、程公、荀公、各位将军，既悉荀彧所汇总之许昌防务首稿，今下令如下以便立刻执行并催成详报。
荀彧、程昱据已汇总资料将许昌防务初稿定稿，标注优先补给项与增援次第并附建议调配缘由，半刻内呈都督部与陛下。
乐进即刻优先点收所缴补给并立账，优先筹措并报可供调发之重弩与辎重马匹数量，逐仓逐队盘点表当刻呈交都督部并标明预计到援时点。
张辽督促四门按既定人数严守，若有短缺即刻从近营调配并报明需增兵数目與物资。
夏侯渊、乐进、于禁继续隐蔽驻点侦察，不得深追敌主力，遇敌重兵优先退守坚固地形并即时传讯都督部与陛下，联络官昼夜直通都督部。
夏侯惇督城内精锐与夜间巡逻，加严内应防范，凡可疑者先行收押并将人名与经由上奏都督部。
徐庶与程昱、荀彧核实内应线索并速报结果。都督部一时辰内将逐项明细汇总上陈陛下。务求速准详，所报即行，遇敌即刻传讯。

程昱:
乐进，今夜子时按约赴许昌城东隐处取徐母家书。
携密袋與核驗清單，仅随一名护送；到手先验三项：家印、折痕、两处私密称谓或笔迹特征。
若两项或以上合符，当场以第①号封签封存并速回程公处；若疑或不符，封存不动，即刻回稟。
路上戒言，不得私语。

徐庶:
程公、张都督，微臣据夏侯渊、乐进、于禁等回报已修订并定稿许昌防务表格与缺口物资清单。
要点速述：四门各约160人，每门弩手40人并昼夜轮换；城垛每垛5名弩手；城内精锐预备约40人由夏侯惇督领。
沿外壕每里三哨每哨50人；三路侦骑各100骑联络官直通都督部；汉水、黄河、博陵渡口置水师与轻骑哨队30–50人/处。
缺口优先：重弩约30架、辎重马约40匹、若干辎重车及重弩维修零件；乐进为点收与调拨责任人。
请二位批示：一、是否即刻按此清单调拨并下令乐进点收？
二、是否批准我方为各哨之哨长与弩务总管之人选或请明示拟任名单？
三、是否准许我将此修订稿整理为逐处表格以便逐项签批并下达执行令？请示批示，微臣即行照办。

汉献帝:
于禁，朕已悉尔前报，今命汝于一时辰内逐项明报下列事项并呈都督部，抄送朕。
一、南、北、东、西四门守备可出动步卒实数，并注明各垛口弩手人数與昼夜轮换班次。
二、可用于巡逻与侦骑之兵数、各队当前驻点坐标與拟分配路线。
三、各粮仓与分储谷帛实存量、可用粮袋数与短缺项，并标明预计到援时点。
四、现有军器（重弩、轻弩、弓、箭等）数量与短缺项。
五、各队联络官姓名、联络方式及其驻点坐标。
六、若有可疑内应，请列人名与初步处置情形。
七、如需外援或增补，详列所需兵力与物资数量、来源與预计到达时点。速呈，所报即行。

夏侯惇:
于禁，承你回报，遵陛下與都督所命，今令如下。
继续就近隐蔽侦探，不得擅自深追敌主力，遇敌重兵即退守坚固地形并即刻传讯都督部与吾。
半刻内书面呈报北门现守与可调出守卒实数、垛口弩手人数與昼夜轮换班次并抄送吾。
同时呈明可用于巡逻与侦骑之兵数、各队当前驻点坐标與拟行路线。
逐仓逐队列明粮饷與军器余量及短缺项，标明护运队、护卫人数、路线與预计到援時点，乐进点收立账。
若有缴获补给或发觉可疑内应，先行收押并押送都督部审问，物证由联络官押运并保全。
情报通合与回报频率照旧（日出日落例报），并与夏侯渊、乐进、夏侯惇保持联络。务求速准详，半刻内将初报呈都督部并抄吾，所闻即奏。
Scene 44 · Wancheng · rounds 64–64
Cao Cao:
(At Wancheng, Cao Cao seals the summons. The summons was drafted by Xun Yu and Cheng Yu. Choose a fast, trustworthy horse at once. Go quietly and ride straight to Xinye. Deliver it privately into Xu Shu's own hands. Keep a low profile on the road. If Liu Bei's forces stop you, turn back to Xuchang at once. If any abnormality occurs, return to Xuchang and report. Bring back exact confirmation of delivery or failure.)
曹操:
(把荀彧、程昱拟的召徐书封好。 现在就挑可信的快马，密送直赴新野，务必将书私下交到徐庶本人手中。 嘱咐使者行事低调，若遇刘备军阻拦或有异常状况，立即折回许昌回报。 不论送达与否，务必带回送达或未达的确切回报。)
Scene 45 · Jiangdong · rounds 64–78
Zhang Zhao:
(inner monologue: (thinking): Drafting candidate list for fifty imperial guards. Zhang Zhao (thinking): List format: Name — Proposed post — Duties — Recommendation. Zhou Tai — Imperial Guard Commander — Protect Sun Quan, lead inner detachments — Proven brave and loyal. Zhu Zhi — Guard Company Leader — Palace watch, guest reception, nightly patrols — Experienced local aide, steady. Zhang Hong — Guard Company Leader — Manage internal duties and guard training — Learned official, good organizer. Lü Fan — Guard Company Leader (boat attendant) — Shipboard guard, escort Sun Quan on water — Skilled in naval affairs. Wang (placeholder) — Guard Company Leader (placeholder) — Night watch and small squad command — For filling ranks, await decision. Chen (placeholder) — Guard Company Leader (placeholder) — Same as above, placeholder for signatures. Note: Ten to twelve leaders each command 4–6 men; rank-and-file fill to fifty. Kuaiji reserve 200 — propose 2–3 deputy generals and station chiefs. Zhu Zhi — Kuaiji Deputy Commander — Organize city garrison, supply, fort works — Local roots suit rear security. Zhou Tai — Kuaiji Garrison Deputy — Gate defense, patrols, emergency reinforcement — Loyal veteran. Lü Fan — Kuaiji Naval Deputy — Patrol rivers and sea, manage boats and convoy routes — Skilled in water operations. Placeholder Zhang (占位) — Kuaiji Deputy — For royal confirmation or Zhang's recommendation. Duties summary: organize 200 garrison, set coastal sentries, liaison with Shentingling. Coastal patrols and convoy deputies — focus on naval patrol, escort, fire-weapon readiness. Han Dang — Coastal Patrol Deputy (naval) — Daily patrols, key-point defense, combat command — Experienced naval commander. Huang Gai — Shipbuilding & Fire-attack Commander — Oversee ship repair, fire weapons, convoy protection — Skilled in fire tactics. Gan Ning — Fast Patrol/Strike Deputy — Small-boat patrols, night raids, interceptions — Suited for quick sorties if trusted. Lü Fan — Convoy Deputy — Manage transport routes, fleet formations, coastal defense liaison. Placeholder Shen (占位) — Coastal Patrol Deputy (placeholder) — For roster completion and signatures. Reserved list by Zhang's colleagues for placeholders: Zhang Hong, Zhu Zhi, Lü Fan, Zhou Tai, Li (占位), Wu (占位). Duty briefs for tables: Imperial guards 50 — constant close protection, shifts, escort duty noted. Kuaiji 200 — garrison, sentries, grain stores, liaison with Shentingling noted. Coastal patrols — sea segments, convoy protection, fire-weapon readiness noted. Presentation option A (sovereign decides): Draft phrasing to request Sun Quan's direct appointment and list core names. Presentation option B (Zhang Zhao recommends): Draft phrasing to note 'Zhang Zhao recommends; await the sovereign's approval' for placeholders.)

Cheng Pu:
Grand Tutor Zhang, I report as follows.
First, order of assignment should be by your presentation to the lord.
If urgent, permit you to submit the list and issue travel orders; I will obey.
Second, travel strength fixed at five hundred and over ten boats.
Han Dang and Huang Gai to serve as my deputy commanders.
Third, please present the list and the travel warrant tomorrow and state departure date.
I will assemble in three days once five hundred is confirmed.
Cheng Pu humbly reports and stands ready.

Taishi Ci:
Mr. Zhang, I have read your plan and reply thus.
On rank, I prefer you to introduce us to Sun Quan for formal appointment.
If matters press, submitting the list and issuing travel orders first is acceptable.
On personnel, I agree Han Dang as naval deputy and Huang Gai for shipworks and fire-attack.
On guards and other deputies, I defer to your recommendations and will follow orders.
On forces and timing, five hundred can assemble in three days.
